local function resizeGamepadHintsFrame(): ()
	gamepadHintsFrame.Size =
		UDim2.new(HotbarFrame.Size.X.Scale, HotbarFrame.Size.X.Offset, 0, (IsTenFootInterface and 95 or 60))
	gamepadHintsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
		HotbarFrame.Position.X.Scale,
		HotbarFrame.Position.X.Offset,
		InventoryFrame.Position.Y.Scale,
		InventoryFrame.Position.Y.Offset - gamepadHintsFrame.Size.Y.Offset - ICON_BUFFER_PIXELS
	)

	local spaceTaken: number = 0

	local gamepadHints: { Instance } = gamepadHintsFrame:GetChildren()
	local filteredGamepadHints: any = {}

	for _, child: Instance in pairs(gamepadHints) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			table.insert(filteredGamepadHints, child)
		end
	end

	--First get the total space taken by all the hints
	for guiObjects = 1, #filteredGamepadHints do
		if filteredGamepadHints[guiObjects]:IsA("GuiObject") then
			filteredGamepadHints[guiObjects].Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -5)
			filteredGamepadHints[guiObjects].Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			spaceTaken = spaceTaken
				+ (
					filteredGamepadHints[guiObjects].HintText.Position.X.Offset
					+ filteredGamepadHints[guiObjects].HintText.TextBounds.X
				)
		end
	end

	--The space between all the frames should be equal
	local spaceBetweenElements: number = (gamepadHintsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X - spaceTaken) / (#filteredGamepadHints - 1)
	for i: number = 1, #filteredGamepadHints do
		filteredGamepadHints[i].Position = (
			i == 1 and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			or UDim2.new(
				0,
				filteredGamepadHints[i - 1].Position.X.Offset
					+ filteredGamepadHints[i - 1].Size.X.Offset
					+ spaceBetweenElements,
				0,
				0
			)
		)
		filteredGamepadHints[i].Size = UDim2.new(
			0,
			(filteredGamepadHints[i].HintText.Position.X.Offset + filteredGamepadHints[i].HintText.TextBounds.X),
			1,
			-5
		)
	end
end

local searchFrame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
do -- Search stuff
	searchFrame.Name = "Search"
	searchFrame.BackgroundColor3 = SEARCH_BACKGROUND_COLOR
	searchFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SEARCH_BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY
	searchFrame.Size = UDim2.new(
		0,
		SEARCH_WIDTH_PIXELS - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 2),
		0,
		INVENTORY_HEADER_SIZE - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 2)
	)
	searchFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -searchFrame.Size.X.Offset - SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS, 0, SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS)
	searchFrame.Parent = InventoryFrame

	local searchFrameCorner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	searchFrameCorner.Name = "Corner"
	searchFrameCorner.CornerRadius = SEARCH_CORNER_RADIUS
	searchFrameCorner.Parent = searchFrame

	local searchFrameBorder: UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	searchFrameBorder.Name = "Border"
	searchFrameBorder.Color = SEARCH_BORDER_COLOR
	searchFrameBorder.Thickness = SEARCH_BORDER_THICKNESS
	searchFrameBorder.Transparency = SEARCH_BORDER_TRANSPARENCY
	searchFrameBorder.Parent = searchFrame

	local searchBox: TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	searchBox.Name = "TextBox"
	searchBox.Text = ""
	searchBox.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	searchBox.TextStrokeTransparency = TEXT_STROKE_TRANSPARENCY
	searchBox.TextStrokeColor3 = TEXT_STROKE_COLOR
	searchBox.FontFace = Font.new(FONT_FAMILY.Family, Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = SEARCH_TEXT_PLACEHOLDER
	searchBox.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	searchBox.TextTransparency = TEXT_STROKE_TRANSPARENCY
	searchBox.TextStrokeColor3 = TEXT_STROKE_COLOR
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	searchBox.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	searchBox.TextSize = FONT_SIZE
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	searchBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(
		0,
		(SEARCH_WIDTH_PIXELS - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 2)) - (SEARCH_TEXT_OFFSET * 2) - 20,
		0,
		INVENTORY_HEADER_SIZE - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 2) - (SEARCH_TEXT_OFFSET * 2)
	)
	searchBox.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, SEARCH_TEXT_OFFSET, 0.5, 0)
	searchBox.ZIndex = 2
	searchBox.Parent = searchFrame

	local xButton: TextButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	xButton.Name = "X"
	xButton.Text = ""
	xButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
	xButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -xButton.Size.X.Offset, 0.5, -xButton.Size.Y.Offset / 2)
	xButton.ZIndex = 4
	xButton.Visible = false
	xButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	xButton.Parent = searchFrame

	local xImage: ImageButton = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	xImage.Name = "X"
	xImage.Image = SEARCH_IMAGE_X
	xImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	xImage.Size = UDim2.new(
		0,
		searchFrame.Size.Y.Offset - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 4),
		0,
		searchFrame.Size.Y.Offset - (SEARCH_BUFFER_PIXELS * 4)
	)
	xImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	xImage.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	xImage.ZIndex = 1
	xImage.BorderSizePixel = 0
	xImage.Parent = xButton

	local function search(): ()
		local terms: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for word: string in searchBox.Text:gmatch("%S+") do
			terms[word:lower()] = true
		end

		local hitTable = {}
		for i: number = NumberOfHotbarSlots + 1, #Slots do -- Only search inventory slots
			local slot = Slots[i]
			local hits: any = slot:CheckTerms(terms)
			table.insert(hitTable, { slot, hits })
			slot.Frame.Visible = false
			slot.Frame.Parent = InventoryFrame
		end

		table.sort(hitTable, function(left: any, right: any): boolean
			return left[2] > right[2]
		end)
		ViewingSearchResults = true

		local hitCount: number = 0
		for _, data in ipairs(hitTable) do
			local slot, hits: any = data[1], data[2]
			if hits > 0 then
				slot.Frame.Visible = true
				slot.Frame.Parent = UIGridFrame
				slot.Frame.LayoutOrder = NumberOfHotbarSlots + hitCount
				hitCount = hitCount + 1
			end
		end

		ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()

		xButton.ZIndex = 3
	end

	local function clearResults(): ()
		if xButton.ZIndex > 0 then
			ViewingSearchResults = false
			for i: number = NumberOfHotbarSlots + 1, #Slots do
				local slot = Slots[i]
				slot.Frame.LayoutOrder = slot.Index
				slot.Frame.Parent = UIGridFrame
				slot.Frame.Visible = true
			end
			xButton.ZIndex = 0
		end
		UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()
	end

	local function reset(): ()
		clearResults()
		searchBox.Text = ""
	end

	local function onChanged(property: string): ()
		if property == "Text" then
			local text: string = searchBox.Text
			if text == "" then
				searchBox.TextTransparency = TEXT_STROKE_TRANSPARENCY
				clearResults()
			elseif text ~= SEARCH_TEXT then
				searchBox.TextTransparency = 0
				search()
			end
			xButton.Visible = text ~= "" and text ~= SEARCH_TEXT
		end
	end

	local function focusLost(enterPressed: boolean): ()
		if enterPressed then
			--TODO: Could optimize
			search()
		end
	end

	xButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(reset)
	searchBox.Changed:Connect(onChanged)
	searchBox.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)

	BackpackScript.StateChanged.Event:Connect(function(isNowOpen: boolean): ()
		-- InventoryIcon:getInstance("iconButton").Modal = isNowOpen -- Allows free mouse movement even in first person

		if not isNowOpen then
			reset()
		end
	end)

	HotkeyFns[Enum.KeyCode.Escape.Value] = function(isProcessed: any): ()
		if isProcessed then -- Pressed from within a TextBox
			reset()
		end
	end
	local function detectGamepad(lastInputType: Enum.UserInputType): ()
		if lastInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 and not UserInputService.VREnabled then
			searchFrame.Visible = false
		else
			searchFrame.Visible = true
		end
	end
	UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(detectGamepad)
end

-- When menu is opend, disable backpack
GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function(): ()
	BackpackGui.Enabled = false
	inventoryIcon:setEnabled(false)
end)

-- When menu is closed, enable backpack
GuiService.MenuClosed:Connect(function(): ()
	BackpackGui.Enabled = true
	inventoryIcon:setEnabled(true)
end)

do -- Make the Inventory expand/collapse arrow (unless TopBar)
	-- selene: allow(unused_variable)
	local removeHotBarSlot = function(name: string, state: Enum.UserInputState, input: InputObject): ()
		if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			return
		end
		if not GuiService.SelectedObject then
			return
		end

		for i: number = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
			if Slots[i].Frame == GuiService.SelectedObject and Slots[i].Tool then
				Slots[i]:MoveToInventory()
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local function openClose(): ()
		if not next(Dragging) then -- Only continue if nothing is being dragged
			InventoryFrame.Visible = not InventoryFrame.Visible
			local nowOpen: boolean = InventoryFrame.Visible
			AdjustHotbarFrames()
			HotbarFrame.Active = not HotbarFrame.Active
			for i: number = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
				Slots[i]:SetClickability(not nowOpen)
			end
		end

		if InventoryFrame.Visible then
			if GamepadEnabled then
				if GAMEPAD_INPUT_TYPES[UserInputService:GetLastInputType()] then
					resizeGamepadHintsFrame()
					gamepadHintsFrame.Visible = not UserInputService.VREnabled
				end
				enableGamepadInventoryControl()
			end
			if BackpackPanel and VRService.VREnabled then
				BackpackPanel:SetVisible(true)
				BackpackPanel:RequestPositionUpdate()
			end
		else
			if GamepadEnabled then
				gamepadHintsFrame.Visible = false
			end
			disableGamepadInventoryControl()
		end

		if InventoryFrame.Visible then
			ContextActionService:BindAction("BackpackRemoveSlot", removeHotBarSlot, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)
		else
			ContextActionService:UnbindAction("BackpackRemoveSlot")
		end

		BackpackScript.IsOpen = InventoryFrame.Visible
		BackpackScript.StateChanged:Fire(InventoryFrame.Visible)
	end

	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
	BackpackScript.OpenClose = openClose -- Exposed
end

-- Now that we're done building the GUI, we Connect to all the major events

-- Wait for the player if LocalPlayer wasn't ready earlier
while not Player do
	task.wait()
	Player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

-- Listen to current and all future characters of our player
Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnCharacterAdded)
if Player.Character then
	OnCharacterAdded(Player.Character)
end

do -- Hotkey stuff
	-- Listen to key down
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(OnInputBegan)

	-- Listen to ANY TextBox gaining or losing focus, for disabling all hotkeys
	UserInputService.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function(): ()
		TextBoxFocused = true
	end)
	UserInputService.TextBoxFocusReleased:Connect(function(): ()
		TextBoxFocused = false
	end)

	-- Manual unequip for HopperBins on drop button pressed
	HotkeyFns[DROP_HOTKEY_VALUE] = function(): () --NOTE: HopperBin
		if ActiveHopper then
			UnequipAllTools()
		end
	end

	-- Listen to keyboard status, for showing/hiding hotkey labels
	UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(OnUISChanged)
	OnUISChanged()

	-- Listen to gamepad status, for allowing gamepad style selection/equip
	if UserInputService:GetGamepadConnected(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1) then
		gamepadConnected()
	end
	UserInputService.GamepadConnected:Connect(function(gamepadEnum: Enum.UserInputType): ()
		if gamepadEnum == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
			gamepadConnected()
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.GamepadDisconnected:Connect(function(gamepadEnum: Enum.UserInputType): ()
		if gamepadEnum == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
			gamepadDisconnected()
		end
	end)
end

-- Sets whether the backpack is enabled or not
function BackpackScript:SetBackpackEnabled(Enabled: boolean): ()
	BackpackEnabled = Enabled
end

-- Returns if the backpack's inventory is open
function BackpackScript:IsOpened(): boolean
	return BackpackScript.IsOpen
end

-- Returns on if the backpack is enabled or not
function BackpackScript:GetBackpackEnabled(): boolean
	return BackpackEnabled
end

-- Returns the BindableEvent for when the backpack state changes
function BackpackScript:GetStateChangedEvent(): BindableEvent
	return BackpackScript.StateChanged
end

-- Update every heartbeat the icon state
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(): ()
	OnIconChanged(BackpackEnabled)
end)

-- Update the transparency of the backpack based on GuiService.PreferredTransparency
local function OnPreferredTransparencyChanged(): ()
	local preferredTransparency: number = GuiService.PreferredTransparency

	BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY = BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY_DEFAULT * preferredTransparency
	InventoryFrame.BackgroundTransparency = BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY

	SLOT_LOCKED_TRANSPARENCY = SLOT_LOCKED_TRANSPARENCY_DEFAULT * preferredTransparency
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots) do
		slot.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = SLOT_LOCKED_TRANSPARENCY
	end

	SEARCH_BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY = SEARCH_BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY_DEFAULT * preferredTransparency
	searchFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SEARCH_BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENCY
end
GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredTransparency"):Connect(OnPreferredTransparencyChanged)

return BackpackScript

	return nil

end

return ProductFinder

items.source:
--!strict
--[[
MAD STUDIO

-[Maid]---------------------------------------

	WARNING: Order of cleanup is undefined!
	
	Functions:
	
		Maid.New(key [any]) --> [Maid]
			-- If "key" is passed, ":Cleanup()" method will be locked
	
	Methods [Maid]:
	
		Maid:IsActive() --> [bool] -- Returns true if maid was not cleaned up
		Maid:Add(any) --> maid_token [MaidToken]
		Maid:Cleanup(...) -- Added functions will receive the tuple arguments;
			After :Cleanup() is called, all successive objects added to the maid will be instantly cleaned up!
			
		Maid:Unlock(key [any]) -- Unlocks ":Cleanup()"
		
	Methods [MaidToken]:
	
		-- Passing a [MaidToken] to "Maid:Add()" will call "MaidToken:Destroy()" on maid cleanup!
	
		MaidToken:Destroy() -- Dissociates object from maid; Cleanup will not be performed
		MaidToken:Cleanup(...) -- Performs cleanup for this object
	
--]]

----- Private -----

local FreeRunnerThread: thread?

--[[
	Yield-safe coroutine reusing by stravant;
	Sources:
	https://devforum.roblox.com/t/lua-signal-class-comparison-optimal-goodsignal-class/1387063
	https://gist.github.com/stravant/b75a322e0919d60dde8a0316d1f09d2f
--]]

local function AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(fn, ...)
	local acquired_runner_thread = FreeRunnerThread
	FreeRunnerThread = nil
	fn(...)
	-- The handler finished running, this runner thread is free again.
	FreeRunnerThread = acquired_runner_thread
end

local function RunEventHandlerInFreeThread(...)
	AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(...)
	while true do
		AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(coroutine.yield())
	end
end

local function Cleanup(object : any, ...)
	
	local object_type = typeof(object)
	
	if object_type == "function" then
		object(...)
	elseif object_type == "RBXScriptConnection" then
		object:Disconnect()
	elseif object_type == "Instance" then
		object:Destroy()
	elseif object_type == "table" then
		if type(object.Destroy) == "function" then
			object:Destroy()
		elseif type(object.Disconnect) == "function" then
			object:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	
end

local function CleanupInThread(...)
	if not FreeRunnerThread then
		FreeRunnerThread = coroutine.create(RunEventHandlerInFreeThread)
	end
	task.spawn(assert(FreeRunnerThread), Cleanup, ...)
end

----- Public -----

--[[
export type MaidToken = {
	Destroy: (self: MaidToken) -> (),
	Cleanup: (self: MaidToken, ...any) -> (),
}

export type Maid = {
	IsActive: (self: Maid) -> (boolean),
	Add: (self: Maid, object: any) -> MaidToken,
	Cleanup: (...any) -> (),
}
--]]

local MaidToken = {}
MaidToken.__index = MaidToken

function MaidToken.New(maid, object : any)
	
	local self = {
		maid = maid,
		object = object,
	}
	
	setmetatable(self, MaidToken)
	
	return self
	
end

function MaidToken:Destroy()
	self.maid.tokens[self] = nil
end

function MaidToken:Cleanup(...)
	
	if self.object == nil then
		return
	end
	
	self.maid.tokens[self] = nil
	CleanupInThread(self.object, ...)
	self.object = nil

end

local Maid = {}
Maid.__index = Maid

function Maid.New(key: any)
	
	local self = {
		tokens = {}, -- [Token] = true, ...
		is_cleaned = false,
		key = key,
	}
	
	setmetatable(self, Maid)
	
	return self
	
end

function Maid:IsActive()
	return not self.is_cleaned
end

function Maid:Add(object: any)
	
	if self.is_cleaned == true then
		CleanupInThread(object)
	end
	
	local object_type = typeof(object)
	
	if object_type == "table" then
		if type(object.Destroy) ~= "function" and type(object.Disconnect) ~= "function" then
			error(`[{script.Name}]: Received table as cleanup object, but couldn't detect a :Destroy() or :Disconnect() method`)
		end
	elseif object_type ~= "function" and object_type ~= "RBXScriptConnection" and object_type ~= "Instance" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Cleanup of type \"{object_type}\" not supported`)
	end
	
	local token = MaidToken.New(self, object)
	self.tokens[token] = true
	
	return token
	
end

function Maid:Cleanup(...)
	
	if self.key ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Cleanup()" is locked for this Maid`)
	end
	
	self.is_cleaned = true
	
	for token in pairs(self.tokens) do
		token:Cleanup(...)
	end
	
end

function Maid:Unlock(key: any)
	if self.key ~= nil and self.key ~= key then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Invalid lock key`)
	end
	self.key = nil
end

return Maid

items.source:
--!strict
--[[
MAD STUDIO

-[RateLimit]---------------------------------------
	Can be used to prevent RemoteEvent spamming; Player references are automatically removed as they leave
	
	Functions:
	
		RateLimit.New(rate, is_full_wait) --> [RateLimit]
			rate           [number] -- Events per second allowed; Excessive events are dropped
			is_full_wait   [bool] -- (Optional) If set to true, allows the next event to happen after the full rate period has passed
			
	Methods [RateLimit]:
	
		RateLimit:CheckRate(source) --> is_to_be_processed [bool] -- Whether event should be processed
			source   [any]
			
		RateLimit:CleanSource(source) -- Forgets about the source - must be called for any object that
			has been passed to RateLimit:CheckRate() after that object is no longer going to be used;
			Does not have to be called for Player instances!
			
		RateLimit:Cleanup() -- Forgets all sources
		
		RateLimit:Destroy() -- Make the RateLimit module forget about this RateLimit object
	
--]]

----- Private -----

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayerReference = {} -- {player = true}
local RateLimits = {} -- {rate_limit = true, ...}

----- Public -----

local RateLimit = {}
RateLimit.__index = RateLimit

function RateLimit.New(rate : number, is_full_wait : boolean?) --> [RateLimit]
	if rate <= 0 then
		error("[RateLimit]: Invalid rate")
	end

	local self = {
		sources = {},
		rate_period = 1 / rate,
		is_full_wait = is_full_wait == true,
	}
	setmetatable(self, RateLimit)

	RateLimits[self] = true

	return self
end

function RateLimit:CheckRate(source) : boolean --> is_to_be_processed [bool] -- Whether event should be processed
	
	local sources = self.sources
	local os_clock = os.clock()
	
	if source == nil then
		source = "nil"
	end
	
	local rate_time: number = sources[source]
	
	if rate_time ~= nil then
		if self.is_full_wait ~= true then
			rate_time = math.max(os_clock, rate_time + self.rate_period)
			if rate_time - os_clock < 1 then
				sources[source] = rate_time
				return true
			else
				return false
			end
		else
			if rate_time <= os_clock then
				sources[source] = os_clock + self.rate_period
				return true
			else
				return false
			end
		end
	else
		-- Preventing from remembering players that already left:
		if typeof(source) == "Instance" and source:IsA("Player")
			and PlayerReference[source] == nil then
			return false
		end
		sources[source] = os_clock + self.rate_period
		return true
	end
	
end

function RateLimit:CleanSource(source) -- Forgets about the source - must be called for any object that
	self.sources[source] = nil
end

function RateLimit:Cleanup() -- Forgets all sources
	self.sources = {}
end

function RateLimit:Destroy() -- Make the RateLimit module forget about this RateLimit object
	RateLimits[self] = nil
end

----- Init -----

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	PlayerReference[player] = true
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	PlayerReference[player] = true
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	PlayerReference[player] = nil
	-- Automatic player reference cleanup:
	for rate_limit in pairs(RateLimits) do
		rate_limit.sources[player] = nil
	end
end)

return RateLimit

items.name: Remote
items.source:
--[[
MAD STUDIO

-[Remote]---------------------------------------
	Remote event setup utility; Prevents duplicate RemoteEvent names server-side

	Functions:
			
		Remote.New(name [string], is_unreliable [bool]) --> [RemoteEvent]
			-- Calling this with the same name server-side twice will throw an error
	
--]]

----- Private -----

local CONTAINER_NAME = "RemoteEvents"
local REMOTE_MISSING_TIME = 20

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local IsStudio = RunService:IsStudio()
local IsServer = RunService:IsServer()
local DefinedRemotes = {} -- [name] = true, ...

local Container, OnContainerReady do
	
	if IsServer == true then
		
		Container = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
		
		if Container ~= nil then
			if IsStudio == true then
				warn(`[{script.Name}]: ReplicatedStorage "{CONTAINER_NAME}" container was already defined`)
			end
		else
			Container = Instance.new("Folder")
			Container.Name = CONTAINER_NAME
			Container.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		end
		
	else
		
		Container = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
		
		if Container == nil then
			
			OnContainerReady = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			
			task.spawn(function()
				while task.wait() do
					Container = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
					if Container ~= nil then
						OnContainerReady:Fire()
						break
					end
				end
			end)
			
		end
		
	end
	
end

----- Public -----

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection.New(fn)
	return setmetatable({
		fn = fn,
		is_disconnected = false,
		real_connection = nil,
	}, Connection)
end

function Connection:Disconnect()
	self.is_disconnected = true
	if self.real_connection ~= nil then
		self.real_connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

local Remote = {}
Remote.__index = Remote

function Remote.New(name: string, is_unreliable: boolean): RemoteEvent
	
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: name must be a string`)
	end
	
	if IsServer == true then
		
		if DefinedRemotes[name] ~= nil then
			error(`[{script.Name}]: RemoteEvent {name} was already defined`)
		end
		
		DefinedRemotes[name] = true
		
		local remote = Instance.new(if is_unreliable == true then "UnreliableRemoteEvent" else "RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = Container
		
		return remote
		
	else
		
		local remote: RemoteEvent = Container and Container:FindFirstChild(name)
		
		if remote ~= nil then
			return remote
		end
		
		local connections = {}
		
		local self = setmetatable({
			OnClientEvent = {
				Connect = function(_, fn)

					if remote ~= nil then
						return remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn)
					else
						local connection = Connection.New(fn)
						table.insert(connections, connection)
						return connection
					end

				end,
			},
			OnServerEvent = {
				Connect = function()
					error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't connect to "OnServerEvent" client-side`)
				end,
			},
			RemoteEvent = nil,
		}, Remote)
		
		local function on_container_ready()
			
			local missing_start = os.clock()

			while true do
				remote = Container:FindFirstChild(name)
				if remote == nil then
					if missing_start ~= nil and os.clock() - missing_start > REMOTE_MISSING_TIME then
						missing_start = nil
						warn(`[{script.Name}]: RemoteEvent "{name}" hasn't been defined server-side`)
					end
					task.wait()
				else
					break
				end
			end

			for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
				if connection.is_disconnected == false then
					connection.real_connection = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(connection.fn)
				end
			end

			self.RemoteEvent = remote
			connections = nil
			
		end
		
		if Container ~= nil then
			task.spawn(on_container_ready)
		else
			local wait_connection
			wait_connection = OnContainerReady.Event:Connect(function()
				wait_connection:Disconnect()
				on_container_ready()
			end)
		end
		
		return self
		
	end
	
end

function Remote:FireServer(...)
	if self.RemoteEvent ~= nil then
		self.RemoteEvent:FireServer(...)
	end
end

function Remote:FireClient()
	error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't use "FireClient" client-side`)
end

function Remote:FireAllClients()
	error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't use "FireAllClients" client-side`)
end

return Remote

items.name: Signal
items.source:
--[[
MAD STUDIO

-[Signal]---------------------------------------
		
	WARNING: Always assume undefined listener invocation order for [Signal] class; Current implementation invokes
		In the backwards order of connection time.

	Functions:
			
		Signal.New() --> [Signal]
		
	Methods [Signal]:
	
		Signal:Connect(listener) --> [Connection] listener(...)
			listener              [function]
			
		Signal:GetListenerCount() --> [number]
			
		Signal:Fire(...)
		
		Signal:Wait()
		
		Signal:FireUntil(continue_callback, ...)
			continue_callback   [function] () --> continue [bool] (Stops firing if "true" is not returned)
		
	Methods [Connection]:
	
		Connection:Disconnect()
	
--]]

----- Private -----

local FreeRunnerThread

--[[
	Yield-safe coroutine reusing by stravant;
	Sources:
	https://devforum.roblox.com/t/lua-signal-class-comparison-optimal-goodsignal-class/1387063
	https://gist.github.com/stravant/b75a322e0919d60dde8a0316d1f09d2f
--]]

local function AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(fn, ...)
	local acquired_runner_thread = FreeRunnerThread
	FreeRunnerThread = nil
	fn(...)
	-- The handler finished running, this runner thread is free again.
	FreeRunnerThread = acquired_runner_thread
end

local function RunEventHandlerInFreeThread(...)
	AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(...)
	while true do
		AcquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(coroutine.yield())
	end
end

----- Public -----

--[[
export type Connection = {
	Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
}

export type Signal = {
	Connect: (self: Signal, listener: (...any) -> ()) -> (Connection),
	GetListenerCount: (self: Signal) -> (number),
	Fire: (self: Signal, ...any) -> (),
	FireUntil: (self: Signal, continue_callback: () -> boolean, ...any) -> (),
}
--]]

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Connection:Disconnect()

	if self.is_connected == false then
		return
	end
	
	local signal = self.signal
	self.is_connected = false
	signal.listener_count -= 1
	
	if signal.head == self then
		signal.head = self.next
	else
		local prev = signal.head
		while prev ~= nil and prev.next ~= self do
			prev = prev.next
		end
		if prev ~= nil then
			prev.next = self.next
		end
	end

end

function Signal.New()

	local self = {
		head = nil,
		listener_count = 0,
	}
	setmetatable(self, Signal)

	return self

end

function Signal:Connect(listener: (...any) -> ())
	
	if type(listener) ~= "function" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: \"listener\" must be a function; Received {typeof(listener)}`)
	end

	local connection = {
		listener = listener,
		signal = self,
		next = self.head,
		is_connected = true,
	}
	setmetatable(connection, Connection)

	self.head = connection
	self.listener_count += 1

	return connection

end

function Signal:GetListenerCount(): number
	return self.listener_count
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
	local item = self.head
	while item ~= nil do
		if item.is_connected == true then
			if not FreeRunnerThread then
				FreeRunnerThread = coroutine.create(RunEventHandlerInFreeThread)
			end
			task.spawn(FreeRunnerThread, item.listener, ...)
		end
		item = item.next
	end
end

function Signal:Wait()
	local co = coroutine.running()
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		task.spawn(co, ...)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:FireUntil(continue_callback: () -> boolean, ...)
	
	if type(continue_callback) ~= "function" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: \"continue_callback\" must be a function; Received {typeof(continue_callback)}`)
	end
	
	local items = {}
	local args = table.pack(...)
	
	local item = self.head
	while item ~= nil do
		table.insert(items, item)
		item = item.next
	end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, check_item in ipairs(items) do
			if check_item.is_connected == true then
				check_item.listener(table.unpack(args))
				if continue_callback() ~= true then
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	
end

return table.freeze({
	New = Signal.New,
})

items.source:
require(script.UIScale)

local UIController = {}

-- services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local StarterGuiService = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- references
local client = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local HUD = client.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui = client.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

-- modules
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local ProductData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Products)

-- constants


-- variables
local blur = SharedUtils.NewInstance("BlurEffect", {Size = 12; Enabled = false; Parent = camera})
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local windows = {}


--[[
TAG INDEX:
	- "Button" - "Type", "Menu"
	- "MenuPrompt" - "Menu"
]]

function UIController.init()	
	for _, window in pairs(MenuGui:GetChildren()) do
		if not window:IsA("Frame") then continue end

		window.Visible = false
		windows[window.Name] = window
	end
	
	UIController.initializeScriptsInFolder(script.HUD)
	UIController.initializeScriptsInFolder(script.Menus)
	
	UIController.Buttons()
	UIController.Prompts()
	
	for _, v in windows do
		v.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -1, 0)
	end
	
	UIController.promptProductPurchases()
end

function UIController.BlurTo(blurSize: number?)
	blurSize = if typeof(blurSize) == "number" then blurSize else 12

	blur.Enabled = true
	local tween = TweenService:Create(blur, tweenInfo, {Size = blurSize})
	if blurSize == 0 then
		tween.Completed:Once(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
				blur.Enabled = false
			end
		end)
	end
	tween:Play()
end

function UIController.FOVTo(fov: number)
	fov = if typeof(fov) == "number" then fov else 70

	TweenService:Create(camera, tweenInfo, {FieldOfView = fov}):Play()
end

function UIController.MenuTween(menuFrame: Frame, onScreen: boolean)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(menuFrame, tweenInfo, {
		Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, if onScreen then .5 else 2)
	})

	if onScreen then
		--.. apply visibility now to see tween in ..--
		menuFrame.Visible = true
	end

	tween.Completed:Connect(function(state: Enum.PlaybackState) 
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
			--.. cover tween off screen ..--
			menuFrame.Visible = onScreen
		end
	end)

	tween:Play()
end

function UIController.OpenGui(menuName: string)
	local menu = windows[menuName]

	if menu == nil or menu.Visible == true then return end

	for _, window in pairs(windows) do
		if window.Visible == true then
			UIController.CloseGui(window.Name)
		end
	end

	HUD.Left.Visible = false

	UIController.MenuTween(menu, true)
	UIController.FOVTo(65)
	UIController.BlurTo(12)
end

function UIController.CloseGui(menuName: string)
	local menu = windows[menuName]

	if menu == nil or menu.Visible == false then return end

	HUD.Left.Visible = true

	UIController.MenuTween(menu, false)
	UIController.FOVTo(70)
	UIController.BlurTo(0)
end

function UIController.Buttons()
	local function scaleHoverButton(button)
		if not button:IsA("GuiButton") then return end

		local UIScale = button:FindFirstChild("UIScale")
		if not UIScale then
			UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			UIScale.Parent = button
		end

		button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			if button:GetAttribute("Type") == "Menu" then
				local menuId = button:GetAttribute("Menu")
				if not menuId or not windows[menuId] then warn(`No menu found "{menuId}" for button {button:GetFullName()}`) return end

				if windows[menuId].Visible == true then
					--SFXModule.Play("Close")
					UIController.CloseGui(menuId)
				else
					--SFXModule.Play("Click")
					UIController.OpenGui(menuId)
				end	
			end

			TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 1}):Play()
			
			if SoundService.SFX:FindFirstChild("click") then
				SoundService.SFX.click:Play()
			end
		end)

		button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 1.1}):Play()
		end)

		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 1.1}):Play()
			
			if SoundService.SFX:FindFirstChild("hover") then
				SoundService.SFX.hover:Play()
			end
		end)

		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 1}):Play()
		end)
	end
	
	for _, button in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Button")) do
		scaleHoverButton(button)
	end
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Button"):Connect(function(button)
		scaleHoverButton(button)
	end)
end

function UIController.Prompts()
	local function OpenMenuOnTrigger(prompt: ProximityPrompt)
		if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") == false then return end

		local menuId = prompt:GetAttribute("Menu")
		if menuId == nil or windows[menuId] == nil then 
			warn(`{prompt:GetFullName()} does not point to any valid menu "{menuId}"`)
			return
		end

		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
			if prompt:GetAttribute("SlotNumber") and menuId == "BladesInventoryFrame" then
				windows[menuId]:SetAttribute("SlotOpened", prompt:GetAttribute("SlotNumber"))
			end
			
			UIController.OpenGui(menuId)
		end)
	end

	for _, prompt in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("MenuPrompt")) do
		task.spawn(OpenMenuOnTrigger, prompt)
	end

	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("MenuPrompt"):Connect(OpenMenuOnTrigger)
end

function UIController.initializeScriptsInFolder(folder: Folder)
	for _, module in folder:GetChildren() do
		if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			continue
		end
		
		if module then
			task.spawn(function()
				local success, result = pcall(require, module)
				if not success then 
					warn(`{module.Name} module require failed. {result}`)
					return 
				end

				local requiredModule = result

				success, result = pcall(requiredModule.init, UIController)
				if not success then
					warn(`{module.Name} module initialization failed. {result}`)
					return
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function UIController.promptProductPurchases()
	local function promptPurchase(productName: string)
		local productInfo = ProductData[productName]
		if not productInfo then
			return
		end
		local productId = productInfo.id
		local productType = productInfo.productType
		
		if productType == Enum.InfoType.Product then
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(client, productId)
		elseif productType == Enum.InfoType.GamePass then
			if MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(client.UserId, productId) then
				return
			end
			
			MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(client, productId)
		end
	end
	
	local function checkButton(button)
		local productName = button:GetAttribute("productName")
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
				promptPurchase(productName)
			end)
		end
		
		
		local priceLabel = button:FindFirstChild("price") 
		if (priceLabel and priceLabel:IsA("TextLabel")) then
			local productInfo = ProductData[productName]
			if not productInfo then
				return
			end
			local productId = productInfo.id
			local info = MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(productId, productInfo.productType)
			if productId > 0 and info then
				priceLabel.Text = `{info.PriceInRobux}`
			end
		end
	end
	
	for _, button in CollectionService:GetTagged("productButton") do
		checkButton(button)
	end
	
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("productButton"):Connect(function(button)
		checkButton(button)
	end)
end

return UIController

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local PHONE_HEIGHT = 320
local PC_HEIGHT = 1080
local TAG = "UIScale"

-- Private variables
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local scales: {[UIScale]: Vector2} = {}
local currentAlpha = 1

-- Private functions
local function getAlpha(viewportSize: number): number
	return math.clamp((viewportSize - PHONE_HEIGHT) / (PC_HEIGHT - PHONE_HEIGHT), 0, 1)
end

local function added(scale: UIScale)
	local minSize = scale:GetAttribute("MinScale") or .75 -- phone size

local PHONE_HEIGHT = 320

local TAG = "UIScale"

-- Private variables
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local scales: {[UIScale]: Vector2} = {}
local currentAlpha = 1

-- Private functions
local function getAlpha(viewportSize: number): number
	return math.clamp((viewportSize - PHONE_HEIGHT) / (PC_HEIGHT - PHONE_HEIGHT), 0, 1)
end

local function added(scale: UIScale)
	local minSize = scale:GetAttribute("MinScale") or .75 -- phone size

	for scale, sizes in scales do

		scale.Scale = math.map(currentAlpha, 0, 1, minSize, maxSize)

camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)

local CashLabelController = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("HUD")
local UIController: UIController?

local function UpdateMoney(money: number, lastNumber: number)
	local shortenValue = SharedUtil.ShortenValue(money)
	HUD.Bottom.Money.Text = `${shortenValue}`
	
	if not lastNumber then
		return
	end
	local change = money - lastNumber
	local clone = HUD.Bottom.Money:Clone()
	clone.Parent = HUD.Bottom.Changes
	clone.Text = `{(if change > 0 then "+" else "-")}${SharedUtil.ShortenValue(math.abs(change))}`
	if change < 0 then
		clone.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 0.278431, 0.278431)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.807843, 0, 0))})
	end
	clone.Size = UDim2.new(1.28, 0, 0, 0)
	TweenService:Create(clone, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(1.28, 0, 0.232, 0)}):Play()
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, 0, false, 2)
	TweenService:Create(clone, tweenInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(clone.UIStroke, tweenInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
end

function CashLabelController.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()

	task.spawn(UpdateMoney, dataReplica.Data.Money)

	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if action == "Set" and path[1] == "Money" then
			UpdateMoney(new, old)
		elseif action == "SetValues" and path[1] == nil and new.Money ~= nil then
			UpdateMoney(new.Money, old.Money)
		end
	end)
end

return CashLabelController

local SeedShopFrame = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local RarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local Module3D = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Module3D)
local ProductData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Products)
local InfoPop = require(script.Parent.Parent.HUD.InfoPop)

local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
local shopNetworker = Networker.client.new("SeedShop", SeedShopFrame)

function SeedShopFrame.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	task.wait(1)
	
	SeedShopFrame.PopulateShop()
	MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.ScrollingFrame.template.Visible = false

	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if action == "Set" and path[1] == "SeedShopInfo" and path[2] == 'StockInfo' then
			local name = path[3]
			SeedShopFrame.updateStock(name)
		elseif action == "SetValues" and path[1] == "SeedShopInfo" and path[2] == "StockInfo" then
			for name, newStock in new do
				SeedShopFrame.updateStock(name)
			end
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(SeedShopFrame.updateTime)
end

function SeedShopFrame.updateTime()
	while true do
		local timeSince = 300 - (os.time() - dataReplica.Data.SeedShopInfo.LastRestock)
		local days, hours, minutes, seconds = SharedUtil.CalculateHoursMinutesSeconds(timeSince)
		MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.WorthHolder.Worth.Text = `New seeds in: {string.format("%02d", minutes)}:{string.format("%02d", seconds)}`

		task.wait(1)
	end
end

function SeedShopFrame.updateStock(name)
	local seedFrame = MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not seedFrame then
		return
	end

	seedFrame.ViewportHolder.Stock.Text = `x{dataReplica.Data.SeedShopInfo.StockInfo[name]} in stock`
end

function SeedShopFrame.PopulateShop()
	for name, info in PlantData do
		if not info.price then
			continue
		end

		local rarity = info.rarity
		local price = info.price
		local productId = ProductData[name]
		if productId then
			productId = productId.id
		else
			productId = 0
		end

		local seedFrame: typeof(MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.ScrollingFrame.template) = MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.ScrollingFrame.template:Clone()
		seedFrame.Parent = MenuGui.Seeds.Frame.ScrollingFrame
		seedFrame.Name = name
		seedFrame.Title.Text = name
		seedFrame.Rarity.Text.Text = rarity
		seedFrame.Rarity.UIGradient.Color = RarityData[rarity].color
		seedFrame.LayoutOrder = price / 200
		
		local object = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if not object then warn("Couldn't find object in assets folder", name) return end
		local objectClone = object:Clone()
		local objectModel = Module3D:Attach3D(seedFrame.ViewportHolder.ViewportFrame, objectClone)
		objectModel:SetDepthMultiplier(1.1)
		objectModel.Camera.FieldOfView = 40
		objectModel.Visible = true
		objectModel:SetCFrame(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(25),0))
		
		local camera = seedFrame.ViewportHolder.ViewportFrame.ViewportFrame.Camera
		camera.Parent = seedFrame.ViewportHolder.ViewportFrame
		seedFrame.ViewportHolder.ViewportFrame.CurrentCamera = camera
		objectClone.Parent = seedFrame.ViewportHolder.ViewportFrame.WorldModel
		
		local idleAnimation = objectClone.Animations.Idle
		local idleTrack = objectClone.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(idleAnimation)
		idleTrack.Looped = true
		idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
		idleTrack:Play()
		
		seedFrame.ViewportHolder.Price.Text = `${SharedUtil.ShortenValue(price)}`
		seedFrame.BuyCash.TextLabel.Text = `${SharedUtil.ShortenValue(price)}`
		if productId > 0 then
			seedFrame.BuyRobux.TextLabel.Text = ` {MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(productId, Enum.InfoType.Product).PriceInRobux}`
		else
			seedFrame.BuyRobux.TextLabel.Text = ` {"nil"}`
		end

		seedFrame.ViewportHolder.Stock.Text = `x{dataReplica.Data.SeedShopInfo.StockInfo[name]} in stock`

		seedFrame.BuyCash.Activated:Connect(function()
			if dataReplica.Data.SeedShopInfo.StockInfo[name] <= 0 then
				InfoPop:runInfo(`No stock.`, Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
				return
			end
			if dataReplica.Data.Money < price then
				InfoPop:runInfo(`You need ${SharedUtil.AddCommas(price - dataReplica.Data.Money)} more.`, Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
				return
			end
			
			game.SoundService.SFX.CollectSlotCash:Play()
			shopNetworker:fire("purchaseSeed", name)
		end)
		seedFrame.BuyRobux:SetAttribute("productName", name)
		seedFrame.BuyRobux:RemoveTag("productButton")
		task.delay(1, function()
			seedFrame.BuyRobux:AddTag("productButton")
		end)
	end
end

return SeedShopFrame

items.source:
local Backpack = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local BackpackGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("BackpackGui", 10)

local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local EnemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local GearData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Gears)

local UIController: UIController?
local itemsShownLabel: typeof(script.ItemsShownLabel)
local categories: typeof(script.Categories)
local autoSell: typeof(script.AutoSell)
local equipBest: typeof(script.EquipBest)
local categoryType: typeof(script.Category)
local equipBestNetworker = Networker.client.new("EquipBest", Backpack)
local equipBestCooldown = false

function Backpack.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	Backpack._addBackpackButtons()
	Backpack._tagAllToolFrames()
	
	Backpack.updateBackpackVisuals()
	
	equipBest.Equip.Buy.Activated:Connect(function()
		if equipBestCooldown then
			return
		end
		equipBestNetworker:fire("equipBestNPCs")
		equipBestCooldown = true
		task.wait(3)
		equipBestCooldown = false
	end)
end

function Backpack.setCategory(name)
	categoryType.Value = name
	Backpack.updateBackpackVisuals()
	itemsShownLabel.Text = name
	
	for _, textButton in categories:GetChildren() do
		if not textButton:IsA("TextButton") then
			continue
		end
		
		textButton.UIStroke.Transparency = if textButton.Name == name then 0 else 1
	end
end

function Backpack._tagAllToolFrames()
	local function tagToolButton(button)
		if not button:FindFirstChild("ToolName") then
			return
		end
		local toolName = button.ToolName.Text
		local correspondingTool = client.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
		if not correspondingTool or toolName == "Shovel [Pick up plants]" then
			return
		end
		
		local name = toolName
		local isASeed = false
		local isAPlant = false
		for word in name:gmatch("%S+") do
			if string.lower(word) == "seed" then
				isASeed = true
			elseif PlantData[word] then
				isAPlant = true
			elseif EnemyData[word] then
				button:AddTag("npcButton")
				return
			elseif GearData[word] then
				button:AddTag("gearButton")
				return
			end
		end
		
		-- check plant names
		for plantName in PlantData do
			if string.find(string.lower(name), string.lower(plantName)) then
				isAPlant = true
				break
			end
		end
		
		if isASeed and isAPlant then
			button:AddTag("seedButton")
			return
		elseif isAPlant then
			button:AddTag("plantButton")
			return
		end
		
		-- check plant names
		for enemyName in EnemyData do
			if string.find(string.lower(name), string.lower(enemyName)) then
				button:AddTag("npcButton")
				return
			end
		end
		
		warn("Couldn't find category for inventory tool:", toolName, button.Name)
	end
	
	for _, textButton in BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory.ScrollingFrame.UIGridFrame:GetChildren() do
		if not textButton:IsA("TextButton") then
			continue
		end
		tagToolButton(textButton)
	end
	
	BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory.ScrollingFrame.UIGridFrame.ChildAdded:Connect(function(textButton)
		if not textButton:IsA("TextButton") then
			return
		end
		tagToolButton(textButton)
		Backpack.updateBackpackVisuals()
	end)
end

function Backpack.updateBackpackVisuals()
	local function showBasedOnCategory(textButton)
		if categoryType.Value == "All" then
			textButton.Visible = true
		elseif categoryType.Value == "Gears" then
			textButton.Visible = textButton:HasTag("gearButton")
		elseif categoryType.Value == "NPCS" then
			textButton.Visible = textButton:HasTag("npcButton")
		elseif categoryType.Value == "Plants" then
			textButton.Visible = textButton:HasTag("plantButton")
		elseif categoryType.Value == "Seeds" then
			textButton.Visible = textButton:HasTag("seedButton")
		end
	end
	
	for _, textButton in BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory.ScrollingFrame.UIGridFrame:GetChildren() do
		if not textButton:IsA("TextButton") then
			continue
		end
		
		showBasedOnCategory(textButton)
	end
end

function Backpack._addBackpackButtons()
	-- showing text
	itemsShownLabel = script.ItemsShownLabel:Clone()
	itemsShownLabel.Parent = BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory
	
	categories = script.Categories:Clone()
	categories.Parent = BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory
	for _, textButton in categories:GetChildren() do
		if not textButton:IsA("TextButton") then
			continue
		end
		
		textButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Backpack.setCategory(textButton.Name)
		end)
	end
	
	autoSell = script.AutoSell:Clone()
	autoSell.Parent = BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory
	
	equipBest = script.EquipBest:Clone()
	equipBest.Parent = BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory
	
	categoryType = script.Category:Clone()
	categoryType.Parent = BackpackGui.Backpack.Inventory
end

return Backpack

local ExpandLanes = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local Zone = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local InfoPop = require(script.Parent.Parent.HUD.InfoPop)

local plot: PlotClient
local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
local laneNetworker = Networker.client.new("ExpandLane", ExpandLanes)
local zoneJanitors = {}
local lanePrices = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.LaneCosts)

function ExpandLanes.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	plot = PlotClient.getPlotObject(client)
	
	ExpandLanes._createLaneButtons()
end

function ExpandLanes._createLaneButtons()
	for laneNumber, _ in plot.MODEL.Lanes.LanesButtons:GetChildren() do
		if dataReplica.Data.Lanes[laneNumber] then
			continue
		end
		local lane = plot.MODEL.Lanes.LanesButtons:WaitForChild(`Lane{laneNumber}`, 5)
		local newZone = Zone.new(lane:WaitForChild("container", 1))
		local _janitor = Janitor.new()
		
		_janitor:Add(newZone.playerEntered:Connect(function()
			if dataReplica.Data.Money >= lanePrices[laneNumber] then
				if MenuGui.Warning.Visible then
					return
				end
				
				-- prompt purchase
				MenuGui.Warning.Title.Text = "Do you want to expand your garden?"
				UIController.OpenGui("Warning")
				
				local menuJanitor = Janitor.new()
				menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning.Yes.Yes.Activated:Connect(function()
					laneNetworker:fire("purchaseLane", laneNumber)
					UIController.CloseGui("Warning")
					menuJanitor:Destroy()
				end), "Disconnect")
				menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					menuJanitor:Destroy()
				end), "Disconnect")
			else
				-- notify how much more money you need
				InfoPop:runInfo(`You need ${SharedUtil.AddCommas(lanePrices[laneNumber] - dataReplica.Data.Money)} more.`, Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		
		zoneJanitors[laneNumber] = _janitor
	end
end

function ExpandLanes:purchasedLane(laneNumber: number)
	local janitor = zoneJanitors[laneNumber]
	if janitor then
		janitor:Destroy()
		zoneJanitors[laneNumber] = nil
	end
end

return ExpandLanes

local PurchasePlatforms = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local CollecitonService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local Zone = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local PlatformPrices = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.PlatformCosts)

local plot: PlotClient
local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
local platformNetworker = Networker.client.new("PurchasePlatform", PurchasePlatforms)
local platformButtonJanitor: Janitor

function PurchasePlatforms.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	plot = PlotClient.getPlotObject(client)
	
	PurchasePlatforms.updatePlatforms()
	PurchasePlatforms._listenForPlatformNPCs()
	PurchasePlatforms._updatePlatformNPCPrompts()
	
	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if action == "Set" and path[1] == "Platforms" then
			local platformNum = path[2]
			PurchasePlatforms.checkUpdateOverheadUI(platformNum)
		elseif action == "SetValues" and path[1] == "Platforms" then
			local platformNum = path[2]
			PurchasePlatforms.checkUpdateOverheadUI(platformNum)
		end
	end)
end

function PurchasePlatforms._updatePlatformNPCPrompts()
	local isHoldingTool = false
	
	-- for updating prompt text
	local function updatePrompt(prompt)
		-- check if there is an npc on the platform
		local platform = prompt.Parent.Parent
		local npc = platform:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
		if (npc and not npc:HasTag("platformNPC")) then
			npc = nil
		end
		
		if npc then
			if isHoldingTool then
				prompt.ActionText = "Swap NPC"
			else
				prompt.ActionText = "Pick up NPC"
			end
		else
			if isHoldingTool then
				prompt.ActionText = "Place NPC"
			else
				prompt.ActionText = "Pick up NPC"
			end
		end
	end
		
	local function updateAllPrompts()
		for _, prompt in CollecitonService:GetTagged("platformNPCPrompt") do
			updatePrompt(prompt)
		end
	end
	updateAllPrompts()
	
	CollecitonService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("platformNPCPrompt"):Connect(updatePrompt)
	
	-- for setting what that text should say
	client.Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:HasTag("npcTool") then
			isHoldingTool = true
		end
		updateAllPrompts()
	end)
	
	client.Backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
		updateAllPrompts()
	end)
	
	client.Character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
		if not child:IsA("Tool") then
			return
		end
		
		isHoldingTool = false
		updateAllPrompts()
	end)
end

function PurchasePlatforms.checkUpdateOverheadUI(platformNumber)
	if not plot then
		return
	end
	local platformInfo = dataReplica.Data.Platforms[platformNumber]
	if platformInfo.NPC ~= nil then
		local platform = plot.MODEL.Platforms.Platforms[`Platform{platformNumber}`]
		local npc = platform:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
		if not npc then
			return
		end
		SharedUtil.updateNPCOverhead(npc, platformInfo.NPC, platformInfo.NPCMultiplier, platformInfo.NPCMutation, platformInfo.Money, platformInfo.OfflineMoney, client)
	end
end

function PurchasePlatforms.updatePlatforms()
	for platformNumber, _ in plot.MODEL.Platforms.Platforms:GetChildren() do
		if dataReplica.Data.Platforms[platformNumber].Unlocked then
			continue
		end
		local platformButton = plot.MODEL.Platforms.Platforms:FindFirstChild(`Platform{platformNumber}`)
		if not platformButton then
			return
		end
		local newZone = Zone.new(platformButton:WaitForChild("container", 1))
		platformButtonJanitor = Janitor.new() :: Janitor
		
		platformButtonJanitor:Add(newZone.playerEntered:Connect(function()
			if dataReplica.Data.Money >= PlatformPrices[platformNumber] then
				if MenuGui.Warning.Visible then
					return
				end
				
				-- prompt purchase
				MenuGui.Warning.Title.Text = `Buy this platform for ${SharedUtil.AddCommas(PlatformPrices[platformNumber])}`
				UIController.OpenGui("Warning")
				
				local menuJanitor = Janitor.new()
				menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning.Yes.Yes.Activated:Connect(function()
					platformNetworker:fire("purchasePlatform", platformNumber)
					UIController.CloseGui("Warning")
				end), "Disconnect")
				menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					menuJanitor:Destroy()
				end), "Disconnect")
			else
				-- notify how much more money you need
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		
	end
end

function PurchasePlatforms:purchasedPlatform(laneNumber: number)
	if platformButtonJanitor then
		platformButtonJanitor:Destroy()
		platformButtonJanitor = nil
	end
	PurchasePlatforms.updatePlatforms()
end

function PurchasePlatforms._listenForPlatformNPCs()
	local function animateModel(model)
		local animations = model:FindFirstChild("Animations")
		if not animations then
			return
		end
		local walkAnimation = animations:FindFirstChild("Walk")
		if not walkAnimation then
			return
		end
		local walkTrack
		if model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			walkTrack = model.Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator"):LoadAnimation(walkAnimation)
		elseif model:FindFirstChild("AnimationController") then
			walkTrack = model.AnimationController:WaitForChild("Animator"):LoadAnimation(walkAnimation)
		end
		walkTrack.Looped = true
		walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
		walkTrack:Play()
	end
	
	for _, model in CollecitonService:GetTagged("platformNPC") do
		animateModel(model)
	end
	
	CollecitonService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("platformNPC"):Connect(animateModel)
end

return PurchasePlatforms

items.source:
local IndexFrame = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local EnemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)
local RarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)
local Module3D = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Module3D)

local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
local selectedGradient = script.UIGradient:Clone()
selectedGradient.Name = "selectGrad"
local indexFrames = {}

function IndexFrame.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	MenuGui.Index.Main.ScrollingFrame.Visible = false
	MenuGui.Index.Main.ScrollingFrame.IndexSlot.Visible = false
	IndexFrame._createFrames()
	
	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if action == "Set" and path[1] == "Index" then
			local mutation = path[2]
			if not MutationData[mutation] then
				return
			end
			IndexFrame.updateIndexFrames()
		end
	end)
end

function IndexFrame.updateIndexFrames()
	for _, frame in indexFrames do
		local name = frame.Name
		local mutation = frame:GetAttribute("mutation")
		
		frame.Title.Text = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutation][name] then name else "???"
		frame.ViewportFrame.Ambient = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutation][name] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		frame.ViewportFrame.LightColor = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutation][name] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		frame.ViewportFrame.ImageColor3 = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutation][name] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end

local function openProperScrollingFrame(name)
	local scrollingFrame = MenuGui.Index.Main:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not scrollingFrame then
		warn("Couldn't find scrolling frame:",name)
		return
	end
	for _, scrollingFrame in MenuGui.Index.Main:GetChildren() do
		if not scrollingFrame:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or scrollingFrame.Name == "Type" then
			continue
		end
		scrollingFrame.Visible = false
	end
	
	scrollingFrame.Visible = true
end

function IndexFrame._createFrames()
	--// create type buttons
	for mutationName, mutationInfo in MutationData do
		local button = MenuGui.Index.Main.Type:FindFirstChild(mutationName)
		if not button then
			warn("Couldn't find button for mutation", mutationName)
			continue
		end
		button.Open.Activated:Connect(function()
			for _, frame in MenuGui.Index.Main.Type:GetChildren() do
				for _, textButton in frame:GetChildren() do
					if textButton:IsA("ImageButton") then
						textButton.UIGradient.Enabled = true
					end
				end
			end
			
			button.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = false
			selectedGradient.Parent = button.Open		
			openProperScrollingFrame(MenuGui.Index.TypeOpen.Value .. mutationName)
		end)
		if button.Name == "Normal" then
			button.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = false
			selectedGradient.Parent = button.Open
		end
	end
	
	--// populate scrolling frames
	local itemsList = {"plants","npcs"}
	for _, item in itemsList do
		for mutationName, mutationInfo in MutationData do
			local clone = MenuGui.Index.Main.ScrollingFrame:Clone()
			clone.Parent = MenuGui.Index.Main
			clone.Name = `{item}{mutationName}`
			if clone.Name == "plantsNormal" then
				clone.Visible = true
			end
			
			local data = if item == "plants" then PlantData else EnemyData
			for thingName, thingInfo in data do
				local frameClone = clone.IndexSlot:Clone()
				frameClone.Parent = clone
				frameClone.Name = thingName
				
				frameClone.Title.Text = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutationName][thingName] then thingName else "???"
				frameClone.ViewportFrame.Ambient = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutationName][thingName] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				frameClone.ViewportFrame.LightColor = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutationName][thingName] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				frameClone.ViewportFrame.ImageColor3 = if dataReplica.Data.Index[mutationName][thingName] then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				
				frameClone.Rarity.Text = thingInfo.rarity
				frameClone.Rarity.UIGradient.Color = RarityData[thingInfo.rarity].color
				frameClone.LayoutOrder = (thingInfo.price or thingInfo.baseSellPrice) / 100
				frameClone.Visible = true
				
				local object = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild(thingName, true)
				if not object then warn("Couldn't find object in assets folder", thingName) return end
				local objectClone = object:Clone()
				local objectModel = Module3D:Attach3D(frameClone.ViewportFrame, objectClone)
				objectModel:SetDepthMultiplier(1.1)
				objectModel.Camera.FieldOfView = 40
				objectModel.Visible = true
				objectModel:SetCFrame(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(25),0))

				local camera = frameClone.ViewportFrame.ViewportFrame.Camera
				camera.Parent = frameClone.ViewportFrame
				frameClone.ViewportFrame.CurrentCamera = camera
				objectClone.Parent = frameClone.ViewportFrame.WorldModel
				
				frameClone:SetAttribute("mutation", mutationName)
				table.insert(indexFrames, frameClone)
			end
		end
	end
	
	--// swap between types
	MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = false
	local typeGrad = selectedGradient:Clone()
	typeGrad.Parent = MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open
	typeGrad.Name = "typeGrad"
	MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Brainrot.Open.Activated:Connect(function()
		MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = true
		typeGrad.Parent = MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Brainrot.Open
		MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Brainrot.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = false
		
		MenuGui.Index.TypeOpen.Value = "npcs"
		openProperScrollingFrame("npcsNormal")
	end)
	
	MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open.Activated:Connect(function()
		MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = false
		typeGrad.Parent = MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Plant.Open
		MenuGui.Index.Main.Categories.Brainrot.Open.UIGradient.Enabled = true
		
		MenuGui.Index.TypeOpen.Value = "plants"
		openProperScrollingFrame("plantsNormal")
	end)
end

return IndexFrame

items.source:
local AutoSellFrame = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)
local RarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)

local dataReplica = DataAggregation.GetReplica()
local UIController: UIController?
local autoSellNetworker = Networker.client.new("AutoSell", AutoSellFrame)
local debounce = false

function AutoSellFrame.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	AutoSellFrame._populateFrames()
	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if path[1] == "AutoSell" then
			local typeChanged = path[2]
			local button = MenuGui.AutoSell.Rarities:FindFirstChild(typeChanged) or MenuGui.AutoSell.Mutations:FindFirstChild(typeChanged)
			local info = MutationData[typeChanged] or RarityData[typeChanged]
			if not button and info then
				warn("Couldn't find mutation/rarity changed", typeChanged)
				return
			end
			button.UIGradient.Enabled = not dataReplica.Data.AutoSell[typeChanged]
			button.off.Enabled = dataReplica.Data.AutoSell[typeChanged]
		end
	end)
	
	MenuGui.AutoSell.MutationToggle.MutationsButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		MenuGui.AutoSell.Rarities.Visible = false
		MenuGui.AutoSell.Mutations.Visible = true
		MenuGui.AutoSell.MutationToggle.MutationsButton.UIGradient.Enabled = false
		MenuGui.AutoSell.MutationToggle.MutationsButton.selected.Enabled = true
		MenuGui.AutoSell.RarityToggle.MutationsButton.UIGradient.Enabled = true
		MenuGui.AutoSell.RarityToggle.MutationsButton.selected.Enabled = false
	end)
	MenuGui.AutoSell.RarityToggle.MutationsButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		MenuGui.AutoSell.Rarities.Visible = true
		MenuGui.AutoSell.Mutations.Visible = false
		MenuGui.AutoSell.MutationToggle.MutationsButton.UIGradient.Enabled = true
		MenuGui.AutoSell.MutationToggle.MutationsButton.selected.Enabled = false
		MenuGui.AutoSell.RarityToggle.MutationsButton.UIGradient.Enabled = false
		MenuGui.AutoSell.RarityToggle.MutationsButton.selected.Enabled = true
	end)
end

function AutoSellFrame._populateFrames()
	local function createButton(name,info, parent)
		local clone = MenuGui.AutoSell.Rarities.template:Clone()
		clone.Parent = parent
		clone.Name = name
		clone.Text.Text = name
		local color = info.color.Keypoints[1].Value -- Color3
		local darker = Color3.new(color.R * 0.7, color.G * 0.7, color.B * 0.7)
		clone.UIGradient.Color = info.color
		clone.UIStroke.Color = darker
		clone.Text.UIStroke.Color = darker
		
		clone.UIGradient.Enabled = not dataReplica.Data.AutoSell[name]
		clone.off.Enabled = dataReplica.Data.AutoSell[name]
		
		clone.Visible = true
		clone.LayoutOrder = info.chance * -10000
		
		clone.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			if debounce then
				return
			end
			autoSellNetworker:fire("update", name)
			debounce = true
			task.wait(0.1)
			debounce = false
		end)
	end
	
	for name, info in RarityData do
		createButton(name,info,MenuGui.AutoSell.Rarities)
	end
	for name, info in MutationData do
		createButton(name,info,MenuGui.AutoSell.Mutations)
	end
end

return AutoSellFrame

items.source:
local StoreFrame = {}
type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")
local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
function StoreFrame.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	task.spawn(StoreFrame._updateServerLuck)
end
function StoreFrame._updateServerLuck()
	local serverLuckFrame = MenuGui.Shop.Main.ScrollingFrame.ServerBoost
	while task.wait(1) do
		local serverLuck = ReplicatedStorage.ServerLuck.Luck.Value
		local timeBought = ReplicatedStorage.ServerLuck.TimeBought.Value
		serverLuckFrame.Next.Visible = true
		serverLuckFrame.Current.Visible = true
		serverLuckFrame.Arrow.Visible = true
		serverLuckFrame.Max.Visible = false
		serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy2.Visible = false
		serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy4.Visible = false
		serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy6.Visible = false
		if timeBought + 15*60 > os.time() then
			serverLuckFrame.Timer.Visible = true
			local days, hours, minutes, seconds = SharedUtils.CalculateHoursMinutesSeconds(timeBought + 15*60 - os.time())
			serverLuckFrame.Timer.Text = `{if hours > 0 then hours..":" else ""}{minutes}:{string.format("%02d", seconds)} left`
			if serverLuck == 6 then
				serverLuckFrame.Next.Visible = false
				serverLuckFrame.Current.Visible = false
				serverLuckFrame.Arrow.Visible = false
				serverLuckFrame.Max.Visible = true
			elseif serverLuck == 4 then
				serverLuckFrame.Next.Text = "6x"
				serverLuckFrame.Current.Text = "4x"
				serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy6.Visible = true
			else
				serverLuckFrame.Next.Text = "4x"
				serverLuckFrame.Current.Text = "2x"
				serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy4.Visible = true
			end
		else
			serverLuckFrame.Timer.Visible = false
			serverLuckFrame.Next.Text = "2x"
			serverLuckFrame.Current.Text = "1x"
			serverLuckFrame.Buy.Buy2.Visible = true
		end
	end
end
return StoreFrame

items.source:
local RebirthController = {}

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local RebirthData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rebirths)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Module3D = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Module3D)
local InfoPop = require(ReplicatedStorage.UIController.HUD.InfoPop)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)

local UIController: UIController?
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()
local rebirthNetworker = Networker.client.new("Rebirth", RebirthController)

function RebirthController.init(_UIController: UIController)
	UIController = _UIController
	
	RebirthController.updateFrame()
	dataReplica:OnChange(function(action, path, new, old)
		if path[1] == "Rebirths" then
			RebirthController.updateFrame()
		end
	end)
	
	MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Rebirth.Claim.Buy.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		local rebirthInfo = RebirthData[dataReplica.Data.Rebirths]
		if not rebirthInfo then
			InfoPop:runInfo("Max rebirths", Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
			return
		end
		
		if dataReplica.Data.Money < rebirthInfo.moneyRequired then
			InfoPop:runInfo("Not enough money", Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
			return
		end
		
		local npcsInBackpack = {}
		local backpack = client.Backpack:GetChildren()
		table.insert(backpack, client.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"))
		for _, tool in backpack do
			if not tool then
				return
			end
			local npcName = tool:GetAttribute("npc")
			if tool:HasTag("npcTool") and npcName ~= nil then
				table.insert(npcsInBackpack, npcName)
			end
		end
		
		if table.find(npcsInBackpack, rebirthInfo.npcRequired1) and table.find(npcsInBackpack, rebirthInfo.npcRequired2) then
			-- prompt purchase
			MenuGui.Warning.Title.Text = "Are you sure you want to rebirth and reset your inventory but keep your plants?"
			UIController.OpenGui("Warning")

			local menuJanitor = Janitor.new()
			menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning.Yes.Yes.Activated:Connect(function()
				rebirthNetworker:fire("doRebirth")
				UIController.CloseGui("Warning")
				menuJanitor:Destroy()
			end), "Disconnect")
			menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				menuJanitor:Destroy()
			end), "Disconnect")
		else
			InfoPop:runInfo("You need all the required brainrots", Color3.new(1, 0, 0.0156863))
		end
	end)
end

function RebirthController.updateFrame()
	local rebirths = dataReplica.Data.Rebirths
	local rebirthInfo = RebirthData[rebirths]
	
	if rebirthInfo then
		MenuGui.Rebirth.MaxRebirths.Visible = false
		MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Visible = true
		
		MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Requirements.Money.Text = `${SharedUtils.AddCommas(RebirthData[rebirths].moneyRequired)}`

		local req1 = RebirthData[rebirths].npcRequired1
		if req1 then
			local frame = MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Requirements.Required["1"]
			
			local existingModel = frame.ViewportFrame.WorldModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
			if existingModel then
				existingModel:Destroy()
			end
			local existingViewmodel = frame.ViewportFrame:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
			if existingViewmodel then
				existingViewmodel:Destroy()
			end
			
			local object = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(req1)
			if not object then warn("Couldn't find object in assets folder", req1) return end
			local objectClone = object:Clone()
			local objectModel = Module3D:Attach3D(frame.ViewportFrame, objectClone)
			objectModel:SetDepthMultiplier(1.1)
			objectModel.Camera.FieldOfView = 40
			objectModel.Visible = true
			objectModel:SetCFrame(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(25),0))

			local camera = frame.ViewportFrame.ViewportFrame.Camera
			camera.Parent = frame.ViewportFrame
			frame.ViewportFrame.CurrentCamera = camera
			objectClone.Parent = frame.ViewportFrame.WorldModel

			frame.TextLabel.Text = req1
		end

		local req2 = RebirthData[rebirths].npcRequired2
		if req2 then
			local frame = MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Requirements.Required["2"]
			
			local existingModel = frame.ViewportFrame.WorldModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
			if existingModel then
				existingModel:Destroy()
			end
			local existingViewmodel = frame.ViewportFrame:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
			if existingViewmodel then
				existingViewmodel:Destroy()
			end
			
			local object = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(req2)
			if not object then warn("Couldn't find object in assets folder", req2) return end
			local objectClone = object:Clone()
			local objectModel = Module3D:Attach3D(frame.ViewportFrame, objectClone)
			objectModel:SetDepthMultiplier(1.1)
			objectModel.Camera.FieldOfView = 40
			objectModel.Visible = true
			objectModel:SetCFrame(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(25),0))

			local camera = frame.ViewportFrame.ViewportFrame.Camera
			camera.Parent = frame.ViewportFrame
			frame.ViewportFrame.CurrentCamera = camera
			objectClone.Parent = frame.ViewportFrame.WorldModel

			frame.TextLabel.Text = req2
		end
	else
		MenuGui.Rebirth.MaxRebirths.Visible = true
		MenuGui.Rebirth.Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

return RebirthController
