items.source:
local self = {}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = client.Character or client.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local mouse = client:GetMouse()
local playerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = playerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")

local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local RarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)
local getRaycastFromMouse = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.getModelFromMouseRaycast)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)

local dataReplica = DataAggregation.WaitForReplica()

function self.init()
	self.plotModel = PlotClient.getPlotModel(client)
	
	self.placementCFrame = CFrame.new()
	self.canPlace = true
	self.placementNetworker = Networker.client.new("PlantService", self)
	self.placeDebounce = false
	
	self.pointer = nil
	self.highlight = nil
	self.equippedTool = nil
	self.placementConnection = nil
	self.plantName = nil
	
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(self.step)
	
	--// equipping functions
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(self.toolEquipped)
	character.ChildRemoved:Connect(self.toolUnequipped)
end

function self.debounce()
	self.placeDebounce = true

	task.wait(0.25)

	self.placeDebounce = false
end

function self.raycastDown()
	local origin = mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local direction = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
	
	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	
	local includeList = {}
	for _, laneFolder in self.plotModel.Lanes.Lanes:GetChildren() do
		if not laneFolder:IsA("Model") or not string.find(laneFolder.Name, "Lane") then
			continue
		end
		for _, part in laneFolder:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("Part") then
				table.insert(includeList, part)
			end
		end
	end
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = includeList
	
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
end

function self.plantSeed()
	if self.placeDebounce then
		return
	end
	if not self.equippedTool then
		return
	end
	if not self.canPlace then
		return
	end
	local raycastResult = self.raycastDown()
	if not raycastResult then
		return
	end
	local lane = raycastResult.Instance.Parent
	if lane.Parent ~= self.plotModel.Lanes.Lanes then
		return
	end
	local laneNumber = tonumber(lane.Name:match("%d+")) -- just gets the numbers that are in the string
	if not laneNumber then
		return
	end
	
	self.placementNetworker:fire("place", self.plantName, raycastResult.Position, laneNumber, (if self.equippedTool:GetAttribute("plantNumber") ~= nil then self.equippedTool else nil))
	task.spawn(self.debounce)
	SoundService.SFX.PlaceSound:Play()
end

function self.toolEquipped(tool: Tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return
	end
	if not tool:HasTag("seed") then
		return
	end	
	local plantName = tool:GetAttribute("plant")
	if not plantName then
		return
	end
	local _plantData = PlantData[plantName]
	if not _plantData then
		return
	end
	
	self.createPointerModel()
	self.equippedTool = tool
	self.plantName = plantName
	
	if self.placementConnection then
		self.placementConnection:Disconnect()
		self.placementConnection = nil
	end
	self.placementConnection = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local platform = SharedUtils.GetPlatform()
		if tool.Parent == client.Character and (platform == "desktop" or platform == "console") then 
			self.plantSeed()
		end
	end)
end

function self.toolUnequipped(tool: Tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return
	end
	if self.placementConnection then
		self.placementConnection:Disconnect()
		self.placementConnection = nil
	end
	if self.pointer and tool:HasTag("seed") and self.equippedTool == tool then
		self.pointer:Destroy()
		self.pointer = nil
		self.highlight:Destroy()
		self.highlight = nil
		self.equippedTool = nil
		self.plantName = nil
	end
end

function self.createPointerModel()
	if self.pointer then
		return
	end
	
	self.pointer = Instance.new("Part")
	self.pointer.Parent = workspace
	self.pointer.Name = "Pointer"
	self.pointer.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	self.pointer.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 2, 2)
	self.pointer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(99, 59, 10)
	self.pointer.CanCollide = false
	self.pointer.Anchored = true
	self.pointer.CanQuery = false
	self.pointer.CanTouch = false
	self.pointer.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	
	self.highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	self.highlight.Parent = self.pointer
	self.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 255, 0)
	self.highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 255, 0)
end

function self.step()
	HUD.PlantName.Visible = false
	if self.pointer then
		local position = mouse.Hit.Position
		self.pointer.Position = position
		
		self.canPlace = false
		
		local raycastResult = self.raycastDown()
		if raycastResult then
			self.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
			self.highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
			self.pointer.Transparency = 0
			
			local lane = raycastResult.Instance.Parent
			if lane.Parent == self.plotModel.Lanes.Lanes then
				self.canPlace = true
			else
				self.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
				self.highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
				self.pointer.Transparency = 1
			end
			local laneNumber = tonumber(lane.Name:match("%d+")) -- just gets the numbers that are in the string
			if laneNumber then
				if not dataReplica.Data.Lanes[laneNumber] then
					self.canPlace = false
				end
			else
				self.canPlace = false
			end
		end
		if SharedUtils.getPlantsPlaced(dataReplica.Data) >= dataReplica.Data.LanesUnlocked * Configuration.MaxPlantsPlacedPerLane then
			self.canPlace = false
		end
		
		if self.canPlace then
			self.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 255, 0)
			self.highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 255, 0)
		else
			self.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 4)
			self.highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 4)
		end
	else
		local includeList = {}
		for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged("plant") do
			if model:IsA("Model") and model:IsDescendantOf(self.plotModel.Plants) then
				table.insert(includeList, model)
			end
		end
		
		local model = getRaycastFromMouse(includeList)
		if model then
			local name = model:GetAttribute("name")
			local rarity = PlantData[name].rarity
			local mutation = model:GetAttribute("mutation")
			local damage = model:GetAttribute("damage")
			
			HUD.PlantName.Text = `{name} ({damage} dmg)`
			HUD.PlantName.Rarity.Text = rarity
			HUD.PlantName.Rarity.UIGradient.Color = RarityData[rarity].color
			if (mutation and mutation ~= "Normal") then
				HUD.PlantName.Mutations.Mutation.Text = mutation
				HUD.PlantName.Mutations.Mutation.UIGradient.Color = MutationData[mutation].color
				HUD.PlantName.Mutations.Visible = true
			else
				HUD.PlantName.Mutations.Visible = false
			end
			HUD.PlantName.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, mouse.X, 0, mouse.Y)
			HUD.PlantName.Visible = true
		end
	end
end

return self

items.name: PickupService
items.source:
local self = {}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = client.Character or client.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local MenuGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local getModelFromMouseRaycast = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.getModelFromMouseRaycast)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local UIController = require(ReplicatedStorage.UIController)

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}

function self.init()
	
	self.PLOT_MODEL = PlotClient.getPlotModel(client)
	self.pickUpNetworker = Networker.client.new("PickUpService", self)
	
	self.equipped = false
	self.hoveringModel = nil :: Model
	self.lastHoveringModel = nil
	
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(self.step)
	
	local shovel = client.Backpack:WaitForChild("Shovel [Pick up plants]")
	shovel.Equipped:Connect(self.toolEquipped)
	shovel.Unequipped:Connect(self.toolUnequipped)
	shovel.Activated:Connect(self.pickUp)
end

function self.toolEquipped()
	self.equipped = true
	self.hoveringModel = nil
end

function self.toolUnequipped()
	self.equipped = false
	self.hoveringModel = nil
	self.lastHoveringModel = nil
	self.tweenOutUnusedHighlights()
end

function self.pickUp()
	if (self.hoveringModel and PlantData[self.hoveringModel.Name] and self.hoveringModel:IsDescendantOf(self.PLOT_MODEL)) then
		if MenuGui.Warning.Visible then
			return
		end
		local savedModel = self.hoveringModel
		
		MenuGui.Warning.Title.Text = "Do you want to pick up this plant?"
		UIController.OpenGui("Warning")
		
		local menuJanitor = Janitor.new()
		menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning.Yes.Yes.Activated:Connect(function()
			SoundService.SFX.PickUpSound:Play()
			self.pickUpNetworker:fire("pickUp", savedModel)
			
			UIController.CloseGui("Warning")
			menuJanitor:Destroy()
		end), "Disconnect")
		menuJanitor:Add(MenuGui.Warning:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			UIController.CloseGui("Warning")
			menuJanitor:Destroy()
		end), "Disconnect")
	end
end

function self.tweenOutUnusedHighlights()
	for _, highlight in CollectionService:GetTagged("redHighlight") do
		TweenService:Create(highlight, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1}):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(highlight, 0.1)
		highlight:RemoveTag("redHighlight")
	end
end

function self.step(deltaTime: number)
	if not self.equipped then
		return
	end
	
	local includeList = {}
	for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged("plant") do
		if model:IsA("Model") and model:IsDescendantOf(self.PLOT_MODEL.Plants) then
			table.insert(includeList, model)
		end
	end
	
	self.hoveringModel = getModelFromMouseRaycast(includeList)
	if self.hoveringModel then
		if self.lastHoveringModel ~= self.hoveringModel then
			if self.lastHoveringModel then
				self.tweenOutUnusedHighlights()
			end
			
			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Parent = self.hoveringModel
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
			highlight:AddTag("redHighlight")
		end
	else
		if (self.lastHoveringModel and self.lastHoveringModel:FindFirstChild("Highlight")) then
			self.tweenOutUnusedHighlights()
		end
	end
	
	self.lastHoveringModel = self.hoveringModel
end

return self

local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

	TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)

		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(message.TextSource.UserId)

		return properties
	end
end

return ChatTag

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")


local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local Replica = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.ReplicaClient)

local musicGroup = SoundService.BackgroundMusic

local pauseMusic = false
local currentlyPlaying = 1
local sounds = {}


for _, sound in ipairs(musicGroup.Cycle:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(sounds, sound)
end

musicGroup.Cycle.ChildAdded:Connect(function(sound)
	table.insert(sounds, sound)
end)


local function PlayMusic()
	pauseMusic = false
	while not pauseMusic do
		local sound: Sound = sounds[currentlyPlaying]
		sound:Play()
		sound.Ended:Wait()
		currentlyPlaying = if currentlyPlaying == #sounds then 1 else currentlyPlaying + 1
		task.wait()	
	end
end

local function StopMusic()
	pauseMusic = true
	for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do
		sound:Stop()
	end
end



local function Main()
	local session = DataAggregation.WaitForSessionReplica()
	
	session:OnSet({"CarryNPCState"}, function(new, old)
		if new == true then
			StopMusic()
			SoundService.BackgroundMusic.StealingMusic:Play()
		else
			if SoundService.BackgroundMusic.StealingMusic.IsPlaying then
				SoundService.BackgroundMusic.StealingMusic:Stop()
			end

			task.spawn(PlayMusic)
		end
	end)
	
	task.spawn(PlayMusic)
end


task.spawn(Main)

return {}

items.source:
local Tutorial = {}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = client.Character or client.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local PlayerGui = client:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local HUD: typeof(game.StarterGui.HUD) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("HUD")
local MenuGui: typeof(game.StarterGui.MenuGui) = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")

local UIController = require(ReplicatedStorage.UIController)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)

type UIController = {
	OpenGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
	CloseGui: (guiName: string) -> nil;
}
local tutorialNetworker = Networker.client.new("Tutorial", Tutorial)
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.GetReplica()
local plotModel: typeof(workspace.Map.Plots.PlotTemplate)

function Tutorial.init()
	plotModel = PlotClient.getPlotObject(client).MODEL
	
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 10 then
		Tutorial.runTutorial()
	end
end

local function showTutorialText(text)
	HUD.Tutorial.ImageTransparency = 1
	HUD.Tutorial.Tutorial.TextTransparency = 1
	HUD.Tutorial.Tutorial.UIStroke.Transparency = 1
	HUD.Tutorial.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0)
	
	local tinfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
	TweenService:Create(HUD.Tutorial, tinfo, {ImageTransparency = 0.8, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.09)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(HUD.Tutorial.Tutorial, tinfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(HUD.Tutorial.Tutorial.UIStroke, tinfo, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	HUD.Tutorial.Tutorial.Text = text
	HUD.Tutorial.Visible = true
end

function Tutorial.runTutorial()
	task.wait(1)
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 2 then
		showTutorialText("Go buy your first plant!")
		
		local beam = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.Beam:Clone()
		beam.Parent = workspace
		beam.Attachment0 = plotModel["NPC's"].Seeds.HumanoidRootPart.RootAttachment
		beam.Attachment1 = character.HumanoidRootPart.RootAttachment
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until MenuGui.Seeds.Visible
		beam:Destroy()
		
		
		
		tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 1) -- update
		
		HUD.Pointer.Position = UDim2.new(0.552, 0,0.541, 0)
		HUD.Pointer.Visible = true
		repeat 
			task.wait()
		until client.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Cactus Seed")
		HUD.Pointer.Visible = false
	end
		
		
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 3 then
		tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 2) -- update
		
		showTutorialText("Now go plant it!")
		UIController.CloseGui("Seeds")
		plotModel.TutorialPart.BillboardGui.Enabled = true
		local beam = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.Beam:Clone()
		beam.Parent = workspace
		beam.Attachment0 = plotModel.TutorialPart.Attachment
		beam.Attachment1 = character.HumanoidRootPart.RootAttachment
		repeat 
			task.wait()
		until plotModel.Plants:FindFirstChild("growing")
		beam:Destroy()
		plotModel.TutorialPart:Destroy()
	end
		
		
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 4 then
		tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 3) -- update
		
		showTutorialText(`Wait for an enemy to come to your garden!`)
		local toolJanitor = Janitor.new()
		toolJanitor:Add(client.Backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:HasTag("npcTool") then
				tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 4) -- update
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		repeat 
			task.wait()
		until dataReplica.Data.Tutorial > 3
		toolJanitor:Destroy()
	end
		
		
		
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 5 then
		showTutorialText(`Place your NPC so it can make money!`)
		local beam = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.Beam:Clone()
		beam.Parent = workspace
		beam.Attachment0 = plotModel.Platforms.Platforms["Platform1"].NPCCframe
		beam.Attachment1 = character.HumanoidRootPart.RootAttachment
		HUD.Pointer.Visible = true
		HUD.Pointer.Rotation = 180
		HUD.Pointer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.507,0.888)
		local npcJanitor = Janitor.new()
		npcJanitor:Add(beam, "Destroy")
		npcJanitor:Add(HUD.Pointer)
		npcJanitor:Add(plotModel.Platforms.Platforms[`Platform1`].ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:HasTag("platformNPC") then
				tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 5) -- update
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		repeat 
			task.wait()
		until dataReplica.Data.Tutorial > 4
		npcJanitor:Destroy()
	end
	
	if dataReplica.Data.Tutorial < 6 then
		showTutorialText(`Jump on it to collect your money!`)
		local beam = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.Beam:Clone()
		beam.Parent = workspace
		beam.Attachment0 = plotModel.Platforms.Platforms["Platform1"].NPCCframe
		beam.Attachment1 = character.HumanoidRootPart.RootAttachment
		repeat 
			task.wait()
		until dataReplica.Data.Money > 1
		HUD.Tutorial:Destroy()
		beam:Destroy()
		
		tutorialNetworker:fire("update", 10) -- finish
		print("Tutorial complete")
	end
end

return Tutorial

items.name: PlantClient
items.source:
local PlantClient = {}
PlantClient.__index = PlantClient

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local EnemyClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.EnemyClient)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local EffectsHandler = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.EffectsHandler)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)

type PlantClient = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	PLAYER: Player,
	NAME: string,
	MODEL: Model,
	LANE: number,
	
	isAttacking: boolean,
}, PlantClient))

function PlantClient.init()
	PlantClient._updateGrowingPlants()
	PlantClient._checkForGrownPlants()
end

--// check for full plants
function PlantClient._checkForGrownPlants()
	local function createNewPlant(model)
		local playerName = model:GetAttribute("playerName")
		if not playerName then
			warn("Couldn't find enemy's player")
			return
		end
		local player = Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
		local name = model:GetAttribute("name")
		if not name or not PlantData[name] then
			warn("Couldn't find plant data")
			return
		end
		local laneNumber = model:GetAttribute("laneNumber")
		
		if not laneNumber or not player then
			warn("Missing plant value")
			return
		end
		
		PlantClient.new(player, name, model, laneNumber)
	end
	
	for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged("plant") do
		createNewPlant(model)
	end
	
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("plant"):Connect(function(model)
		createNewPlant(model)
	end)
end

--// grow plants
function PlantClient._updateGrowingPlants()
	local growingParts = {}
	
	for _, part in CollectionService:GetTagged("growingPart") do
		if not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not part:IsA("Part") then
			continue
		end
		
		table.insert(growingParts, part)
	end
	
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("growingPart"):Connect(function(child)
		if not child:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not child:IsA("Part") then
			return
		end
		
		table.insert(growingParts, child)
	end)
	
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)

			local removeParts = {}
			for index, part: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.growing) in growingParts do
				if part.Parent then
					local plantName = part:GetAttribute("name")
					local timePlaced = part:GetAttribute("timePlaced")
					local timeToGrow = PlantData[plantName].timeToGrow
					local timeTillComplete = timeToGrow - (os.time() - timePlaced)

					local days, hours, minutes, seconds = SharedUtils.CalculateHoursMinutesSeconds(timeTillComplete)
					days = if days > 0 then `{days}d ` else ""
					hours = if (hours > 0 or days ~= "") then `{hours}h ` else ""
					minutes = if (minutes > 0 or hours ~= "" or days ~= "") then `{minutes}m ` else ""
					seconds = `{seconds}s`
					part.Stats.TimeLeft.Text = `({days .. hours .. minutes .. seconds})`
					part.Stats.PercentGrown.Text = `{SharedUtils.RoundNumber((1 - timeTillComplete / timeToGrow) * 100, 1)}%`
				else
					table.insert(removeParts, index)
				end
			end
			for _, index in removeParts do
				table.remove(growingParts, index)
			end
		end
	end)
end

--// METHODS
function PlantClient.new(player: Player, plantName: string, model: Model, laneNumber: number)
	local self = setmetatable({}, PlantClient)
	
	self.PLAYER = player
	self.NAME = plantName
	self.DATA = PlantData[self.NAME]
	if not self.DATA then
		warn("Couldn't find data for plant")
		return
	end
	self.MODEL = model
	self.LANE = laneNumber
	self.PLOT_CLIENT = PlotClient.getPlotObject(player)
	self.MUTATION = model:GetAttribute("mutation")
	self.MULTIPLIER = model:GetAttribute("multiplier")
	self.DAMAGE = model:GetAttribute("damage")
	
	local attackAnimation = self.MODEL.Animations.Attack
	self.attackTrack = self.MODEL.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(attackAnimation)
	self.attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	
	self.isAttacking = false
	
	local idleAnimation = self.MODEL.Animations.Idle
	local idleTrack = self.MODEL.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(idleAnimation)
	idleTrack.Looped = true
	idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
	idleTrack:Play()
	
	table.insert(self.PLOT_CLIENT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], self)
	
	self:_listenForModelDestroyed()
	
	return self
end

function PlantClient._listenForModelDestroyed(self: PlantClient)
	self.MODEL.AncestryChanged:Once(function()
		if not self.NAME then
			return
		end

		if self.MODEL == nil then
			self:destroy()
		else
			if self.MODEL.Parent == nil then
				self:destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

function PlantClient.runAttack(self: PlantClient, targetModel: Model)
	if not targetModel then
		return
	end
	if not self.MODEL then
		return
	end
	
	self.attackTrack:Play()
	local _, size = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies[targetModel.Name]:GetBoundingBox()
	local targetPos = targetModel:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)
	
	local sound = SoundService.SFX.PlantAttack:FindFirstChild(self.NAME)
	task.spawn(EffectsHandler[`{self.NAME}Attack`], self.MODEL, targetPos, sound)
	local direction = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
	if self.MODEL:GetPivot().Position.Z > targetPos.Z then
		direction = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	end
	self.MODEL:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.MODEL:GetPivot().Position) * direction)
end

function PlantClient.destroy(self: PlantClient)
	if self.PLOT_CLIENT then
		table.remove(self.PLOT_CLIENT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], table.find(self.PLOT_CLIENT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], self))
	end
	
	-- Clear all keys in the table
	for k in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

return PlantClient

local EnemyClient = {}
EnemyClient.__index = EnemyClient

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local enemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local PlotClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Classes.PlotClient)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)

local enemySpawnNetworker = Networker.client.new("EnemySpawn", EnemyClient)
local activeEnemies = {}

local function formatNumber(num)
	local suffixes = {"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc"}
	local suffixIndex = 1

	while num >= 1000 and suffixIndex < #suffixes do
		num = num / 1000
		suffixIndex = suffixIndex + 1
	end

	if num >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d%s", math.floor(num), suffixes[suffixIndex])
	elseif num >= 10 then
		return string.format("%.1f%s", math.floor(num * 10) / 10, suffixes[suffixIndex])
	else
		return string.format("%.2f%s", math.floor(num * 100) / 100, suffixes[suffixIndex])
	end
end

type EnemyClient = typeof(setmetatable({
	{} :: {
		NAME: string;
		DATA: enemyData;
		LANE: number;
		PLOT: typeof(workspace.Map.Plots.PlotTemplate);
		MODEL: Model;
		_janitor: Janitor;
	}, EnemyClient
}))

function EnemyClient.init()
	EnemyClient._listenForEnemiesSpawned()
end

function EnemyClient._listenForEnemiesSpawned()
	local function createNewEnemy(enemyModel)
		local playerName = enemyModel:GetAttribute("playerName")
		if not playerName then
			warn("Couldn't find enemy's player")
			return
		end
		local player = Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
		local plotNumber = enemyModel:GetAttribute("plotNumber")
		local name = enemyModel:GetAttribute("name")
		if not enemyData[name] then
			warn("Couldn't find data for enemy")
			return
		end
		local laneNumber = enemyModel:GetAttribute("laneNumber")
		local mutation = enemyModel:GetAttribute("mutation")
		local multiplier = enemyModel:GetAttribute("multiplier")
		
		if not player or not plotNumber or not name or not laneNumber then
			warn("Missing value when spawning enemy")
			return
		end
		
		EnemyClient.new(EnemyClient, player, plotNumber, enemyModel, name, laneNumber, mutation)
	end
	
	for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged("enemy") do
		createNewEnemy(model)
	end

	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("enemy"):Connect(function(model: Model)
		createNewEnemy(model)
	end)
end

function EnemyClient.getEnemyFromModel(model: Model)
	for _, enemyObject in activeEnemies do
		if enemyObject.MODEL == model then
			return enemyObject
		end
	end
end

local function getPlotModelFromNumber(number: number)
	return workspace.Map.Plots:FindFirstChild(`Plot{number}`)
end

function EnemyClient.new(self, player: Player, plotNumber: number, enemyModel: Model, name: string, lane: number, mutation: string?, multiplier)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EnemyClient)
	
	self.PLAYER = player
	self.NAME = name
	self.DATA = enemyData[name]
	if not self.DATA then
		warn("Couldn't find enemy data")
		return
	end
	self.LANE = lane
	self.PLOT = getPlotModelFromNumber(plotNumber)
	self.MUTATION = mutation
	self.MULTIPLIER = multiplier
	self._janitor = Janitor.new()
	self.PLOT_CLIENT = PlotClient.getPlotObject(player)
	
	--// create model
	self.MODEL = enemyModel
	
	self.maxHealth = self.MODEL:GetAttribute("maxHealth")
	self.health = self.maxHealth
	self._janitor:Add(self.MODEL, "Destroy")
	
	--// walk down lanes
	task.spawn(self.walk, self)
	
	-- play animation
	local walkAnimation = self.MODEL.Animations.Walk
	local walkTrack
	if self.MODEL:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		walkTrack = self.MODEL.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(walkAnimation)
	elseif self.MODEL:FindFirstChild("AnimationController") then
		walkTrack = self.MODEL.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(walkAnimation)
	end
	
	walkTrack.Looped = true
	walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	walkTrack:Play()
	
	self:_listenForModelDestroyed()
	
	return self
end

function EnemyClient._listenForModelDestroyed(self: EnemyClient)
	self.MODEL.AncestryChanged:Once(function()
		task.wait(.1)
		if not self.NAME then
			return
		end
		
		if self.MODEL == nil then
			self:destroy()
		else
			if self.MODEL.Parent == nil then
				self:destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

function EnemyClient.damage(self: EnemyClient, amount: number)
	if not self.health or (self.health and self.health <= 0) then
		return
	end
	
	self.health -= amount
	self.health = math.max(0, self.health)
	
	if self.health <= 0 then
		self:destroy()
		return
	end
	
	local overheadUI: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.EnemyOverhead) = self.MODEL:FindFirstChild("EnemyOverhead")
	if not overheadUI then
		return
	end
	
	overheadUI.Health.Amount.Text = `{formatNumber(self.health)}/{formatNumber(self.maxHealth)} HP`
	overheadUI.Health.Filler.Size = UDim2.fromScale(self.health / self.maxHealth, 1)
end

function EnemyClient.tweenTo(self: EnemyClient, startingCFrame: CFrame, endingCFrame: CFrame, timeToMove: number)
	local position = Instance.new("Vector3Value")
	local direction = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	
	local startingPosition = startingCFrame.Position
	local endingPosition = endingCFrame.Position
	
	position.Value = startingPosition
	direction.Value = startingCFrame
	
	self.positionTween = TweenService:Create(position, TweenInfo.new(timeToMove, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Value = endingPosition})
	self.directionTween = TweenService:Create(direction, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Value = endingCFrame})
	self.positionTween:Play()
	self.directionTween:Play()
	local movingCon = position:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		self.MODEL:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.Value) * direction.Value.Rotation)
	end)
	
	self.positionTween.Completed:Wait()

	movingCon:Disconnect()
	position:Destroy()
	direction:Destroy()
end

function EnemyClient.walk(self: EnemyClient)
	--// walk down road
	local leftorright = {"Left", "Right"}
	local sidechosen = leftorright[math.random(1,2)]
	
	local startingPosition = self.PLOT.EnemySpawn.Waypoints:FindFirstChild(`{sidechosen}Spawn`).WorldCFrame.Position
	local endingPosition = self.PLOT.EnemySpawn.Waypoints:FindFirstChild(`{sidechosen}Exit`).WorldCFrame.Position
	
	self:tweenTo(CFrame.new(startingPosition) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), CFrame.new(endingPosition) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), 7)
	
	--// walk to lane
	local lane = self.PLOT.Lanes.Lanes:FindFirstChild(`Lane{self.LANE}`)
	if not lane then
		warn("Couldn't find lane model")
		return
	end
	local startingPosition = endingPosition
	local endingCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lane.Waypoints.Enter.WorldCFrame.Position, endingPosition) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	self:tweenTo(CFrame.new(startingPosition) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), endingCFrame, 3)
	
	if self.PLOT_CLIENT then
		table.insert(self.PLOT_CLIENT.enemiesInLanes[self.LANE], self)
	else
		return
	end
		
	--// walk down lane
	local startingCFrame = endingCFrame
	local endingCFrame = CFrame.new(lane.Waypoints.Exit.WorldCFrame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	self:tweenTo(startingCFrame, endingCFrame, 20)
	
	self:destroy()
end

function EnemyClient.destroy(self: EnemyClient)
	if not self._janitor then
		return
	end
	
	self._janitor:Destroy()
	
	if self.directionTween then
		self.directionTween:Cancel()
	end
	if self.positionTween then
		self.positionTween:Cancel()
	end
	
	if self.PLOT_CLIENT then
		table.remove(self.PLOT_CLIENT.enemiesInLanes[self.LANE], table.find(self.PLOT_CLIENT.enemiesInLanes[self.LANE], self))
	end
	
	
	-- Clear all keys in the table
	for k in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

return EnemyClient

local PlotClient = {}
PlotClient.__index = PlotClient

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)

local plotNetworker = Networker.client.new("PlotService", {})
local activePlayerPlots = {}

type PlotClient = typeof(setmetatable({
	
}, PlotClient))

function PlotClient.init()
	for _, player in Players:GetChildren() do
		PlotClient.new(player)
	end

	PlotClient._listenForPlayers()
end

function PlotClient._listenForPlayers()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		PlotClient.new(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local plot = activePlayerPlots[player]
		if not plot then
			return
		end
		
		plot:destroy()
	end)
end

function PlotClient.getPlotModel(player: Player)
	return activePlayerPlots[player].MODEL
end

function PlotClient.getPlotObject(player)
	return activePlayerPlots[player]
end

function PlotClient.new(player: Player)
	local self = setmetatable({}, PlotClient)
	
	self.PLAYER = player
	self.MODEL = plotNetworker:fetch("GetOwnersPlotModel")
	
	self.plantsInLanes = {}
	self.enemiesInLanes = {}
	for _ = 1, 7 do
		table.insert(self.enemiesInLanes, {})
		table.insert(self.plantsInLanes, {})
	end
	
	-- attack enemies when inside lane
	for laneNumber, enemiesInLane in self.enemiesInLanes do
		task.spawn(self._attackEnemiesInLane, self, laneNumber)
	end
	
	activePlayerPlots[player] = self
	
	return self
end

--// METHODS
function PlotClient._attackEnemiesInLane(self: PlotClient, laneNumber: number)
	while self.PLAYER and self.PLAYER.Parent do
		local enemies = self.enemiesInLanes[laneNumber]
		if #enemies > 0 then			
			-- loop through plants in the lane
			for _, plant in self.plantsInLanes[laneNumber] do
				if not plant.isAttacking and plant.MODEL ~= nil then
					plant.isAttacking = true

					local target = enemies[1]
					if not target then
						continue
					end
					plant:runAttack(target.MODEL)
					task.delay(0.2, target.damage, target, plant.DAMAGE)

					task.delay(Configuration.PlantAttackSpeed, function()
						plant.isAttacking = false
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

function PlotClient:destroy()
	activePlayerPlots[self.PLAYER] = nil
	
	-- Clear all keys in the table
	for k in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

return PlotClient

items.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")




local SharedUtils = {}

function SharedUtils.ShortenValue(value: number): string
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" then return end
	local Suffixes = {'K', 'M', 'B', 'T', "qd", "Qn", "SX", "Sp", "O", "N", "de", "Ud", "DD", "tdD"}
	if value < 1000 then
		return tostring(value)
	else
		local i = math.min(math.floor(math.log(value, 1000)), #Suffixes)
		local shortValue = value / (1000 ^ i)

		local formatted
		if shortValue < 10 then
			formatted = string.format("%.2f", shortValue)
		elseif shortValue < 100 then
			formatted = string.format("%.1f", shortValue)
		else
			formatted = string.format("%.0f", shortValue)
		end

		return formatted .. Suffixes[i]
	end
end

function SharedUtils.AddCommas(number: number): string
	local formatted = number
	local k
	
	while true do  
		formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
		if (k==0) then
			break
		end
	end
	
	return formatted
end

function SharedUtils.NumberToOrdinal(number: number) : string
	local suffix = "th"
	local lastDigit = number % 10
	local lastTwoDigits = number % 100

	if lastDigit == 1 and lastTwoDigits ~= 11 then
		suffix = "st"
	elseif lastDigit == 2 and lastTwoDigits ~= 12 then
		suffix = "nd"
	elseif lastDigit == 3 and lastTwoDigits ~= 13 then
		suffix = "rd"
	end

	return tostring(number) .. suffix
end

function SharedUtils.SecondsToMMSS(seconds: number)
	return `{string.format("%02d", seconds // 60)}:{string.format("%02d", seconds % 60)}`
end

function SharedUtils.RXYZFromV3(v3: Vector3) : (number, number, number)
	return math.rad(v3.X), math.rad(v3.Y), math.rad(v3.Z)
end

function SharedUtils.NewInstance(className: string, properties : {[string] : any})
	local inst = Instance.new(className)

	for property, value in pairs(properties) do
		inst[property] = value
	end

	return inst
end

function SharedUtils.CalculateHoursMinutesSeconds(totalseconds: number)
	local totalminutes = math.floor(totalseconds / 60)
	local totalhours = math.floor(totalminutes / 60)
	local totaldays = math.floor(totalhours / 24)
	local days = totaldays
	local hours = totalhours - totaldays * 24
	local minutes = totalminutes - totalhours * 60
	local seconds = totalseconds - totalminutes * 60

	return days, hours, minutes, seconds
end

function SharedUtils.GetPlatform()
	if (GuiService:IsTenFootInterface()) then
		return "console"
	elseif (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled) then
		--touchscreen computers now have touchenabled so make sure to check for lack of mouse too
		--also, not all phones/tablets have accelerometer and/or gyroscope
		local DeviceSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize;
		if ( DeviceSize.Y > 600 ) then
			return "tablet"
		else
			return "phone"
		end
	else
		return "desktop"
	end
end

function SharedUtils.RoundNumber(number: number, decimals)
	decimals = decimals or 0
	return math.round(number * (10 ^ decimals)) / (10 ^ decimals)
end

function SharedUtils.PopulateViewportWithModel(viewport: ViewportFrame, model: Model, cameraOffset: Vector3?)
	model = model:Clone()
	model.Parent = viewport

	local modelCFrame, modelSize = model:GetBoundingBox()

	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)) 

	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 30
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera

	local largestDimension = math.max(modelSize.X, modelSize.Y, modelSize.Z)
	local defaultOffset = Vector3.new(largestDimension*2, largestDimension*2, largestDimension*2)

	local finalOffset = cameraOffset or defaultOffset

	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(finalOffset, Vector3.new(0, modelSize.Y/2, 0))
	
	return model
end

function SharedUtils.getPlantsPlaced(data)
	local count = 0
	for laneNumber, laneInfo in data.Plants do
		if laneInfo == nil then
			continue
		end
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local EnemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)
function SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(name, multiplier, mutation, player)
	local data = PlantData[name] or EnemyData[name]
	if not data then
		return
	end
	multiplier = multiplier or 1
	local mutMult = if MutationData[mutation] then MutationData[mutation].multiplier else 1
	
	local baseSellPrice = if data.baseSellPrice then data.baseSellPrice else data.price * 0.05
	local sellPrice = baseSellPrice * multiplier * mutMult
	
	if (player and player:FindFirstChild("VIP")) then
		sellPrice *= 1.5
	end
	
	return math.floor(sellPrice)
end

function SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(name, multiplier, mutation, player)
	local data = PlantData[name] or EnemyData[name]
	if not data then
		return
	end
	multiplier = multiplier or 1
	local mutationMultiplier = if MutationData[mutation] then MutationData[mutation].multiplier else 1

	local moneyPerSecond = data.baseMoneyPerSecond * multiplier * mutationMultiplier
	if (player and player:FindFirstChild("VIP")) then
		moneyPerSecond *= 1.5
	end

	return math.floor(moneyPerSecond)
end

local rarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)
function SharedUtils.updateNPCOverhead(npc, name, multiplier, mutation, money, offlineMoney, player)
	if not npc then
		warn("No npc given to add overhead ui to")
		return
	end
	
	if not name then
		warn("No name was given")
		return
	end
	
	local rarity = EnemyData[name].rarity

	
	local gui = npc:FindFirstChild("NPCOverhead", true) :: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.NPCOverhead)
	if not gui then
		gui = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.NPCOverhead:Clone()
		gui.Parent = npc
		gui.Adornee = npc
		local _, size = npc:GetBoundingBox()
		gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, size.Y + 2, 0)
	end
	
	gui.Mutation.Visible = (mutation ~= nil and mutation ~= "Normal")
	if mutation then
		gui.Mutation.Text = mutation
	end
	gui.Title.Text = name
	gui.Rarity.Text = rarity
	gui.Rarity.Rare.Color = rarityData[rarity].color
	gui.MoneyLabel.Text = `{if (money and money > 0) then `${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(money)} ` else ""}(${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(name, multiplier, mutation, player))}/s)`
	gui.OfflineLabel.Visible = (offlineMoney ~= nil and offlineMoney > 0)
	if offlineMoney ~= nil then
		gui.OfflineLabel.Text = `(${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(offlineMoney or 0)} offline)`
	end
end

return SharedUtils

items.name: EffectsHandler
items.source:
local EffectsHandler = {}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local playSoundAtLocation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.PlaySoundAtPosition)

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local cashEffectNetworker = Networker.client.new("CashEffect", EffectsHandler)

local function runEffects(attachment: Attachment)
	for _, particleEmitter: ParticleEmitter in attachment:GetChildren() do
		if not particleEmitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			continue
		end
		
		local emitCount = particleEmitter:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local emitDelay = particleEmitter:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
		local emitDuration = particleEmitter:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
		
		task.spawn(function()
			--if emitDelay then
			--	task.wait(emitDelay)
			--end
			if emitCount then
				particleEmitter:Emit(emitCount)
			end
			if emitDuration then
				particleEmitter.Enabled = true
				task.wait(emitDuration)
				particleEmitter.Enabled = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function createHitEffect(attachment, targetPosition, sound)
	--// create hit effect
	local hitEffect = attachment:Clone()
	hitEffect.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	hitEffect.WorldPosition = targetPosition
	Debris:AddItem(hitEffect, 1)
	runEffects(hitEffect)
	if sound then
		playSoundAtLocation(sound, targetPosition, 0.4, 50)
	end
	return hitEffect
end

local function createFireBall(ball, shot, targetPosition: Vector3)
	--// create projectile ball clone
	local ballClone = ball:Clone()
	ballClone.Parent = workspace.VFX
	ballClone.Transparency = 0
	local shot = shot:Clone()
	shot.Parent = ballClone
	shot.Position = ballClone.Position
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = ballClone
	weld.Part1 = shot
	
	--// tween projectile
	local travelTime = (ballClone.Position - targetPosition).Magnitude / 150
	TweenService:Create(ballClone, TweenInfo.new(travelTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = targetPosition}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(shot, TweenInfo.new(travelTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = targetPosition}):Play()
	
	Debris:AddItem(ballClone, travelTime)
	
	task.delay(travelTime, createHitEffect, shot.Mid,targetPosition, SoundService.SFX.PlantAttack.HitSounds.Explosion)
	
	return travelTime
end

function EffectsHandler:CashEffect(Position: Vector3)
	local sound = SoundService.SFX.Cash
	local effect = createHitEffect(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.VFX.Cash, Position, sound)
	effect.Parent = client.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	effect.CFrame = CFrame.new(0,0,0)
end

return {
	["CashEffect"] = function()
		local sound = SoundService.SFX.Cash
		local effect = createHitEffect(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.VFX.Cash, client.Character:GetPivot().Position, sound)
		effect.Parent = client.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		effect.CFrame = CFrame.new(0,0,0)
	end,
	
	--// PLANT ATTACKS
	["CactusAttack"] = function(cactusModel: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants.Cactus), targetPosition: Vector3, sound)
		task.wait(0.2)
		--// hide models ball
		local ball = cactusModel.Ball
		ball.Transparency = 1
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			ball.Transparency = 0
		end)
		
		if sound then
			playSoundAtLocation(sound, cactusModel:GetPivot().Position, 0.4, 50)
		end
		local travelTime = createFireBall(ball, ReplicatedStorage.Assets.VFX.CactusShot, targetPosition)
	end,
	["StrawberryAttack"] = function(model: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants.Strawberry), targetPosition: Vector3, sound)
		task.wait(0.2)
		
		local ball = model.Head:Clone()
		ball.Transparency = 1
		
		if sound then
			playSoundAtLocation(sound, model:GetPivot().Position, 0.4, 50)
		end
		
		local travelTime = createFireBall(ball, ReplicatedStorage.Assets.VFX.StrawberryShot, targetPosition)
		Debris:AddItem(ball, travelTime + 0.5)
	end,
	["SunflowerAttack"] = function(model: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants.Sunflower), targetPosition: Vector3, sound)
		task.wait(0.45)

items.name: PlaySoundAtPosition
items.source:
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local client = game.Players.LocalPlayer

return function(sound: Sound, position: Vector3, volume: number, maxDistance: number)
	maxDistance = maxDistance or sound.RollOffMaxDistance
	if (client.Character:GetPivot().Position - position).Magnitude > maxDistance then
		return
	end
	
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	attachment.WorldPosition = position
	
	local soundClone = sound:Clone()
	soundClone.Parent = attachment
	soundClone.Volume = volume or soundClone.Volume
	soundClone.RollOffMaxDistance = maxDistance
	soundClone.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	soundClone:Play()
	
	Debris:AddItem(attachment, soundClone.TimeLength / soundClone.PlaybackSpeed)
end

items.name: getModelFromMouseRaycast
items.source:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- getModelFromMouseRaycast
return function(include, doExclude)
	-- Get the 2D position of the mouse on the screen
	local mousePos = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)

	-- Create a ray from the camera through the mouse position
	local unitRay = camera:ScreenPointToRay(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y)
	local rayOrigin = unitRay.Origin
	local rayDirection = unitRay.Direction * 100 -- cast out 1000 studs

	-- Raycast params (optional: filter out the player’s character)
	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = include
	raycastParams.FilterType = (doExclude and Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude or Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include)

	local result = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)

	if result then
		-- Traverse up the hierarchy to find the model
		local part = result.Instance
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			return model
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end

local applyMutation = {
	["Normal"] = function(part: Part)
		-- nothing

		part.Color = Color3.new(1, 0.829694, 0.270115)

	end,
	["Rainbow"] = function(part: Part)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
	end,
}







-- ======================
-- DONT WORRY ABOUT BELOW
-- ======================

return function(model: Model, multiplier: number, mutation: string)
	if not model then
		return
	end
	multiplier = multiplier or 1
	mutation = mutation or "Normal"
	
	-- SCALE
	model:ScaleTo(multiplier)
	
	-- MUTATE
	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if not part:IsA("MeshPart") and not part:IsA("UnionOperation") and not part:IsA("Part") then
			continue
		end
		
		applyMutation[mutation](part)
	end
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Shared = script:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Util = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Util"))

if RunService:IsClient() == false then
	error("Server scripts cannot require the client library. Please require the server library to use Cmdr in your own code.")
end

local Cmdr do
	Cmdr = setmetatable({
		ReplicatedRoot = script;
		RemoteFunction = script:WaitForChild("CmdrFunction");
		RemoteEvent = script:WaitForChild("CmdrEvent");
		ActivationKeys = {[Enum.KeyCode.F2] = true};
		Enabled = true;
		MashToEnable = false;
		ActivationUnlocksMouse = false;
		HideOnLostFocus = true;
		PlaceName = "Cmdr";
		Util = Util;
		Events = {};
	}, {
		-- This sucks, and may be redone or removed
		-- Proxies dispatch methods on to main Cmdr object
		__index = function (self, k)
			local r = self.Dispatcher[k]
			if r and type(r) == "function" then
				return function (_, ...)
					return r(self.Dispatcher, ...)
				end
			end
		end
	})

	Cmdr.Registry = require(Shared.Registry)(Cmdr)
	Cmdr.Dispatcher = require(Shared.Dispatcher)(Cmdr)
end

if StarterGui:WaitForChild("Cmdr") and wait() and Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("Cmdr") == nil then
	StarterGui.Cmdr:Clone().Parent = Player.PlayerGui
end

local Interface = require(script.CmdrInterface)(Cmdr)

--- Sets a list of keyboard keys (Enum.KeyCode) that can be used to open the commands menu
function Cmdr:SetActivationKeys (keysArray)
	self.ActivationKeys = Util.MakeDictionary(keysArray)
end

--- Sets the place name label on the interface
function Cmdr:SetPlaceName (name)
	self.PlaceName = name
	Interface.Window:UpdateLabel()
end

--- Sets whether or not the console is enabled
function Cmdr:SetEnabled (enabled)
	self.Enabled = enabled
end

--- Sets if activation will free the mouse.
function Cmdr:SetActivationUnlocksMouse (enabled)
	self.ActivationUnlocksMouse = enabled
end

--- Shows Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Show ()
	if not self.Enabled then
		return
	end

	Interface.Window:Show()
end

--- Hides Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Hide ()
	Interface.Window:Hide()
end

--- Toggles Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Toggle ()
	if not self.Enabled then
		return self:Hide()
	end

	Interface.Window:SetVisible(not Interface.Window:IsVisible())
end

--- Enables the "Mash to open" feature
function Cmdr:SetMashToEnable(isEnabled)
	self.MashToEnable = isEnabled

	if isEnabled then
		self:SetEnabled(false)
	end
end

--- Sets the hide on 'lost focus' feature.
function Cmdr:SetHideOnLostFocus(enabled)
	self.HideOnLostFocus = enabled
end

--- Sets the handler for a certain event type
function Cmdr:HandleEvent(name, callback)
	self.Events[name] = callback
end

-- Only register when we aren't in studio because don't want to overwrite what the server portion did
if RunService:IsServer() == false then
	Cmdr.Registry:RegisterTypesIn(script:WaitForChild("Types"))
	Cmdr.Registry:RegisterCommandsIn(script:WaitForChild("Commands"))
end

-- Hook up event listener
Cmdr.RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name, ...)
	if Cmdr.Events[name] then
		Cmdr.Events[name](...)
	end
end)

require(script.DefaultEventHandlers)(Cmdr)

return Cmdr

-- luacheck: ignore 212
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

return function (Cmdr)
	local AutoComplete = {
		Items = {};
		ItemOptions = {};
		SelectedItem = 0;
	}

	local Util = Cmdr.Util
	local Shorthands = Util.MakeDictionary({"me", "all", ".", "*", "others"})

	local Gui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Cmdr"):WaitForChild("Autocomplete")
	local AutoItem = Gui:WaitForChild("TextButton")
	local Title = Gui:WaitForChild("Title")
	local Description = Gui:WaitForChild("Description")
	local Entry = Gui.Parent:WaitForChild("Frame"):WaitForChild("Entry")
	AutoItem.Parent = nil

	-- Helper function that sets text and resizes labels
	local function SetText(obj, textObj, text, sizeFromContents)
		obj.Visible = text ~= nil
		textObj.Text = text or ""

		if sizeFromContents then
			textObj.Size = UDim2.new(0, Util.GetTextSize(text or "", textObj, Vector2.new(1000, 1000), 1, 0).X, obj.Size.Y.Scale, obj.Size.Y.Offset)
		end
	end

	-- Update the info display (Name, type, and description) based on given options.
	local function UpdateInfoDisplay (options)
		-- Update the objects' text and sizes
		SetText(Title, Title.Field, options.name, true)
		SetText(Title.Field.Type, Title.Field.Type, options.type and ": " .. options.type:sub(1, 1):upper() .. options.type:sub(2))
		SetText(Description, Description.Label, options.description)

		Description.Label.TextColor3 = options.invalid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 73, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		-- Calculate needed width and height
		local infoWidth = Title.Field.TextBounds.X + Title.Field.Type.TextBounds.X

		local guiWidth = math.max(infoWidth, Gui.Size.X.Offset)
		Description.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)

		-- Flow description text
		while not Description.Label.TextFits do
			Description.Size = Description.Size + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)

			if Description.Size.Y.Offset > 500 then
				break
			end
		end

		-- Update container
		wait()
		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, guiWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
	end

	--- Shows the auto complete menu with the given list and possible options
	-- item = {typedText, suggestedText, options?=options}
	-- The options table is optional. `at` should only be passed into AutoComplete::Show
	-- name, type, and description may be passed in an options dictionary inside the items as well
	-- options.at?: the character index at which to show the menu
	-- options.name?: The name to display in the info box
	-- options.type?: The type to display in the info box
	-- options.prefix?: The current type prefix (%Team)
	-- options.description?: The description for the currently active info box
	-- options.invalid?: If true, description is shown in red.
	-- options.isLast?: If true, auto complete won't keep going after this argument.
	function AutoComplete:Show (items, options)
		options = options or {}

		-- Remove old options.
		for _, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			if item.gui then
				item.gui:Destroy()
			end
		end

		-- Reset state
		self.SelectedItem = 1
		self.Items = items
		self.Prefix = options.prefix or ""
		self.LastItem = options.isLast or false
		self.Command = options.command
		self.Arg = options.arg
		self.NumArgs = options.numArgs
		self.IsPartial = options.isPartial

		-- Generate the new option labels
		local autocompleteWidth = 200

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			local leftText = item[1]
			local rightText = item[2]

			if Shorthands[leftText] then
				leftText = rightText
			end

			local btn = AutoItem:Clone()
			btn.Name = leftText .. rightText
			btn.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
			btn.Typed.Text = leftText
			btn.Suggest.Text = string.rep(" ", #leftText) .. rightText:sub(#leftText + 1)
			btn.Parent = Gui
			btn.LayoutOrder = i

			local maxBounds = math.max(btn.Typed.TextBounds.X, btn.Suggest.TextBounds.X) + 20
			if maxBounds > autocompleteWidth then
				autocompleteWidth = maxBounds
			end

			item.gui = btn
		end

		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()

		-- Todo: Use TextService to find accurate position for auto complete box
		local text = Entry.TextBox.Text
		local words = Util.SplitString(text)
		if text:sub(#text, #text) == " " and not options.at then
			words[#words+1] = "e"
		end
		table.remove(words, #words)
		local extra = (options.at and options.at or (#table.concat(words, " ") + 1)) * 7

		-- Update the auto complete container
		Gui.Position = UDim2.new(0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.X - 10 + extra, 0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.Y + 30)
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, autocompleteWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
		Gui.Visible = true

		-- Finally, update thge info display
		UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[1] and self.Items[1].options or options)
	end

	--- Returns the selected item in the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem ()
		if Gui.Visible == false then
			return nil
		end

		return AutoComplete.Items[AutoComplete.SelectedItem]
	end

	--- Hides the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:Hide ()
		Gui.Visible = false
	end

	--- Returns if the menu is visible
	function AutoComplete:IsVisible ()
		return Gui.Visible
	end

	--- Changes the user's item selection by the given delta
	function AutoComplete:Select (delta)
		if not Gui.Visible then return end

		self.SelectedItem = self.SelectedItem + delta

		if self.SelectedItem > #self.Items then
			self.SelectedItem = 1
		elseif self.SelectedItem < 1 then
			self.SelectedItem = #self.Items
		end

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			item.gui.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
		end

		if self.Items[self.SelectedItem] and self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options then
			UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options or {})
		end
	end

	return AutoComplete
end

-- Here be dragons
-- luacheck: ignore 212
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local LINE_HEIGHT = 20
local WINDOW_MAX_HEIGHT = 300
local MOUSE_TOUCH_ENUM = {Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, Enum.UserInputType.Touch}

--- Window handles the command bar GUI
local Window = {
	Valid = true,
	AutoComplete = nil,
	ProcessEntry = nil,
	OnTextChanged = nil,
	Cmdr = nil,
	HistoryState = nil,
}

local Gui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Cmdr"):WaitForChild("Frame")
local Line = Gui:WaitForChild("Line")
local Entry = Gui:WaitForChild("Entry")

Line.Parent = nil

--- Update the text entry label
function Window:UpdateLabel()
	Entry.TextLabel.Text = Player.Name .. "@" .. self.Cmdr.PlaceName .. "$"
end

--- Get the text entry label
function Window:GetLabel()
	return Entry.TextLabel.Text
end

--- Recalculate the window height
function Window:UpdateWindowHeight()
	local windowHeight = LINE_HEIGHT

	for _, child in pairs(Gui:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			windowHeight = windowHeight + child.Size.Y.Offset
		end
	end

	Gui.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(Gui.CanvasSize.X.Scale, Gui.CanvasSize.X.Offset, 0, windowHeight)
	Gui.Size =
		UDim2.new(
		Gui.Size.X.Scale,
		Gui.Size.X.Offset,
		0,
		windowHeight > WINDOW_MAX_HEIGHT and WINDOW_MAX_HEIGHT or windowHeight
	)

	Gui.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(windowHeight - 300, 0, math.huge))
end

--- Add a line to the command bar
function Window:AddLine(text, options)
	options = options or {}
	text = tostring(text)

	if typeof(options) == "Color3" then
		options = { Color = options }
	end

	if #text == 0 then
		Window:UpdateWindowHeight()
		return
	end

	local str = self.Cmdr.Util.EmulateTabstops(text or "nil", 8)
	local line = Line:Clone()
	line.Size =
		UDim2.new(
		line.Size.X.Scale,
		line.Size.X.Offset,
		0,
		TextService:GetTextSize(
			str,
			line.TextSize,
			line.Font,
			Vector2.new(Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.X, math.huge)
		).Y + (LINE_HEIGHT - line.TextSize)
	)
	line.Text = str
	line.TextColor3 = options.Color or line.TextColor3
	line.RichText = options.RichText or false
	line.Parent = Gui
end

--- Returns if the command bar is visible
function Window:IsVisible()
	return Gui.Visible
end

--- Sets the command bar visible or not
function Window:SetVisible(visible)
	Gui.Visible = visible

	if visible then
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
		self:SetEntryText("")

		if self.Cmdr.ActivationUnlocksMouse then
			self.PreviousMouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		end
	else
		Entry.TextBox:ReleaseFocus()
		self.AutoComplete:Hide()

		if self.PreviousMouseBehavior then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = self.PreviousMouseBehavior
			self.PreviousMouseBehavior = nil
		end
	end
end

--- Hides the command bar
function Window:Hide()
	return self:SetVisible(false)
end

--- Shows the command bar
function Window:Show()
	return self:SetVisible(true)
end

--- Sets the text in the command bar text box, and captures focus
function Window:SetEntryText(text)
	Entry.TextBox.Text = text

	if self:IsVisible() then
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
		Entry.TextBox.CursorPosition = #text + 1
	end
end

--- Gets the text in the command bar text box
function Window:GetEntryText()
	return Entry.TextBox.Text:gsub("\t", "")
end

--- Sets whether the command is in a valid state or not.
-- Cannot submit if in invalid state.
function Window:SetIsValidInput(isValid, errorText)
	Entry.TextBox.TextColor3 = isValid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 73, 73)
	self.Valid = isValid
	self._errorText = errorText
end

function Window:HideInvalidState()
	Entry.TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

--- Event handler for text box focus lost
function Window:LoseFocus(submit)
	local text = Entry.TextBox.Text

	self:ClearHistoryState()

	if Gui.Visible and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		-- self:SetEntryText("")
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
	elseif GuiService.MenuIsOpen and Gui.Visible then
		self:Hide()
	end

	if submit and self.Valid then
		wait()
		self:SetEntryText("")
		self.ProcessEntry(text)
	elseif submit then
		self:AddLine(self._errorText, Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 153))
	end
end

function Window:TraverseHistory(delta)
	local history = self.Cmdr.Dispatcher:GetHistory()

	if self.HistoryState == nil then
		self.HistoryState = {
			Position = #history + 1;
			InitialText = self:GetEntryText();
		}
	end

	self.HistoryState.Position = math.clamp(self.HistoryState.Position + delta, 1, #history + 1)

	self:SetEntryText(
		self.HistoryState.Position == #history + 1
			and self.HistoryState.InitialText
			or history[self.HistoryState.Position]
	)
end

function Window:ClearHistoryState()
	self.HistoryState = nil
end

function Window:SelectVertical(delta)
	if self.AutoComplete:IsVisible() and not self.HistoryState then
		self.AutoComplete:Select(delta)
	else
		self:TraverseHistory(delta)
	end
end

local lastPressTime = 0
local pressCount = 0
--- Handles user input when the box is focused
function Window:BeginInput(input, gameProcessed)
	if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		self:Hide()
	end

	if gameProcessed and self:IsVisible() == false then
		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.ActivationKeys[input.KeyCode] then -- Activate the command bar
		if self.Cmdr.MashToEnable and not self.Cmdr.Enabled then
			if tick() - lastPressTime < 1 then
				if pressCount >= 5 then
					return self.Cmdr:SetEnabled(true)
				else
					pressCount = pressCount + 1
				end
			else
				pressCount = 1
			end
			lastPressTime = tick()
		elseif self.Cmdr.Enabled then
			self:SetVisible(not self:IsVisible())
			wait()
			self:SetEntryText("")

			if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then -- Special case for menu getting stuck open (roblox bug)
				self:Hide()
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.Enabled == false or not self:IsVisible() then
		if self:IsVisible() then
			self:Hide()
		end

		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.HideOnLostFocus and table.find(MOUSE_TOUCH_ENUM, input.UserInputType) then
		local ps = input.Position
		local ap = Gui.AbsolutePosition
		local as = Gui.AbsoluteSize
		if ps.X < ap.X or ps.X > ap.X + as.X or ps.Y < ap.Y or ps.Y > ap.Y + as.Y then
			self:Hide()
		end
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then -- Auto Complete Down
		self:SelectVertical(1)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then -- Auto Complete Up
		self:SelectVertical(-1)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then -- Eat new lines
		wait()
		self:SetEntryText(self:GetEntryText():gsub("\n", ""):gsub("\r", ""))
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then -- Auto complete
		local item = self.AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem()
		local text = self:GetEntryText()
		if item and not (text:sub(#text, #text):match("%s") and self.AutoComplete.LastItem) then
			local replace = item[2]
			local newText
			local insertSpace = true
			local command = self.AutoComplete.Command

			if command then
				local lastArg = self.AutoComplete.Arg

				newText = command.Alias
				insertSpace = self.AutoComplete.NumArgs ~= #command.ArgumentDefinitions and self.AutoComplete.IsPartial == false

				local args = command.Arguments
				for i = 1, #args do
					local arg = args[i]
					local segments = arg.RawSegments
					if arg == lastArg then
						segments[#segments] = replace
					end

					local argText = arg.Prefix .. table.concat(segments, ",")

					-- Put auto completion options in quotation marks if they have a space
					if argText:find(" ") or argText == "" then
						argText = ("%q"):format(argText)
					end

					newText = ("%s %s"):format(newText, argText)

					if arg == lastArg then
						break
					end
				end
			else
				newText = replace
			end
			-- need to wait a frame so we can eat the \t
			wait()
			-- Update the text box
			self:SetEntryText(newText .. (insertSpace and " " or ""))
		else
			-- Still need to eat the \t even if there is no auto-complete to show
			wait()
			self:SetEntryText(self:GetEntryText())
		end
	else
		self:ClearHistoryState()
	end
end

-- Hook events
Entry.TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(
	function(submit)
		return Window:LoseFocus(submit)
	end
)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
	function(input, gameProcessed)
		return Window:BeginInput(input, gameProcessed)
	end
)

Entry.TextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(
	function()
		if Entry.TextBox.Text:match("\t") then -- Eat \t
			Entry.TextBox.Text = Entry.TextBox.Text:gsub("\t", "")
			return
		end
		if Window.OnTextChanged then
			Gui.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(Gui.CanvasSize.Height.Offset - 300, 0, math.huge))
			return Window.OnTextChanged(Entry.TextBox.Text)
		end
	end
)

Gui.ChildAdded:Connect(Window.UpdateWindowHeight)

return Window

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local CreateGui = require(script.Parent.CreateGui)

--- Handles initial preparation of the game server-side.
return function (cmdr)
	local ReplicatedRoot, RemoteFunction, RemoteEvent

	local function Create (class, name, parent)
		local object = Instance.new(class)
		object.Name = name
		object.Parent = parent or ReplicatedRoot

		return object
	end

	ReplicatedRoot = script.Parent.CmdrClient

	if ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Resources") and
		ReplicatedStorage.Resources:FindFirstChild("Libraries") then -- If using RoStrap
		-- ReplicatedRoot.Name = "Cmdr"
		ReplicatedRoot.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Resources.Libraries
	else
		ReplicatedRoot.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	RemoteFunction = Create("RemoteFunction", "CmdrFunction")
	RemoteEvent = Create("RemoteEvent", "CmdrEvent")

	Create("Folder", "Commands")
	Create("Folder", "Types")

	script.Parent.Shared.Parent = ReplicatedRoot

	cmdr.ReplicatedRoot = ReplicatedRoot
	cmdr.RemoteFunction = RemoteFunction
	cmdr.RemoteEvent = RemoteEvent

	cmdr:RegisterTypesIn(script.Parent.BuiltInTypes)

	script.Parent.BuiltInTypes:Destroy()
	script.Parent.BuiltInCommands.Name = "Server commands"

	if StarterGui:FindFirstChild("Cmdr") == nil then
		CreateGui()
	end
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Shared = script:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Util = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Util"))

if RunService:IsClient() == false then
	error("Server scripts cannot require the client library. Please require the server library to use Cmdr in your own code.")
end

local Cmdr do
	Cmdr = setmetatable({
		ReplicatedRoot = script;
		RemoteFunction = script:WaitForChild("CmdrFunction");
		RemoteEvent = script:WaitForChild("CmdrEvent");
		ActivationKeys = {[Enum.KeyCode.F2] = true};
		Enabled = true;
		MashToEnable = false;
		ActivationUnlocksMouse = false;
		HideOnLostFocus = true;
		PlaceName = "Cmdr";
		Util = Util;
		Events = {};
	}, {
		-- This sucks, and may be redone or removed
		-- Proxies dispatch methods on to main Cmdr object
		__index = function (self, k)
			local r = self.Dispatcher[k]
			if r and type(r) == "function" then
				return function (_, ...)
					return r(self.Dispatcher, ...)
				end
			end
		end
	})

	Cmdr.Registry = require(Shared.Registry)(Cmdr)
	Cmdr.Dispatcher = require(Shared.Dispatcher)(Cmdr)
end

if StarterGui:WaitForChild("Cmdr") and wait() and Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("Cmdr") == nil then
	StarterGui.Cmdr:Clone().Parent = Player.PlayerGui
end

local Interface = require(script.CmdrInterface)(Cmdr)

--- Sets a list of keyboard keys (Enum.KeyCode) that can be used to open the commands menu
function Cmdr:SetActivationKeys (keysArray)
	self.ActivationKeys = Util.MakeDictionary(keysArray)
end

--- Sets the place name label on the interface
function Cmdr:SetPlaceName (name)
	self.PlaceName = name
	Interface.Window:UpdateLabel()
end

--- Sets whether or not the console is enabled
function Cmdr:SetEnabled (enabled)
	self.Enabled = enabled
end

--- Sets if activation will free the mouse.
function Cmdr:SetActivationUnlocksMouse (enabled)
	self.ActivationUnlocksMouse = enabled
end

--- Shows Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Show ()
	if not self.Enabled then
		return
	end

	Interface.Window:Show()
end

--- Hides Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Hide ()
	Interface.Window:Hide()
end

--- Toggles Cmdr window
function Cmdr:Toggle ()
	if not self.Enabled then
		return self:Hide()
	end

	Interface.Window:SetVisible(not Interface.Window:IsVisible())
end

--- Enables the "Mash to open" feature
function Cmdr:SetMashToEnable(isEnabled)
	self.MashToEnable = isEnabled

	if isEnabled then
		self:SetEnabled(false)
	end
end

--- Sets the hide on 'lost focus' feature.
function Cmdr:SetHideOnLostFocus(enabled)
	self.HideOnLostFocus = enabled
end

--- Sets the handler for a certain event type
function Cmdr:HandleEvent(name, callback)
	self.Events[name] = callback
end

-- Only register when we aren't in studio because don't want to overwrite what the server portion did
if RunService:IsServer() == false then
	Cmdr.Registry:RegisterTypesIn(script:WaitForChild("Types"))
	Cmdr.Registry:RegisterCommandsIn(script:WaitForChild("Commands"))
end

-- Hook up event listener
Cmdr.RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name, ...)
	if Cmdr.Events[name] then
		Cmdr.Events[name](...)
	end
end)

require(script.DefaultEventHandlers)(Cmdr)

return Cmdr

-- luacheck: ignore 212
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

return function (Cmdr)
	local AutoComplete = {
		Items = {};
		ItemOptions = {};
		SelectedItem = 0;
	}

	local Util = Cmdr.Util
	local Shorthands = Util.MakeDictionary({"me", "all", ".", "*", "others"})

	local Gui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Cmdr"):WaitForChild("Autocomplete")
	local AutoItem = Gui:WaitForChild("TextButton")
	local Title = Gui:WaitForChild("Title")
	local Description = Gui:WaitForChild("Description")
	local Entry = Gui.Parent:WaitForChild("Frame"):WaitForChild("Entry")
	AutoItem.Parent = nil

	-- Helper function that sets text and resizes labels
	local function SetText(obj, textObj, text, sizeFromContents)
		obj.Visible = text ~= nil
		textObj.Text = text or ""

		if sizeFromContents then
			textObj.Size = UDim2.new(0, Util.GetTextSize(text or "", textObj, Vector2.new(1000, 1000), 1, 0).X, obj.Size.Y.Scale, obj.Size.Y.Offset)
		end
	end

	-- Update the info display (Name, type, and description) based on given options.
	local function UpdateInfoDisplay (options)
		-- Update the objects' text and sizes
		SetText(Title, Title.Field, options.name, true)
		SetText(Title.Field.Type, Title.Field.Type, options.type and ": " .. options.type:sub(1, 1):upper() .. options.type:sub(2))
		SetText(Description, Description.Label, options.description)

		Description.Label.TextColor3 = options.invalid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 73, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		-- Calculate needed width and height
		local infoWidth = Title.Field.TextBounds.X + Title.Field.Type.TextBounds.X

		local guiWidth = math.max(infoWidth, Gui.Size.X.Offset)
		Description.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)

		-- Flow description text
		while not Description.Label.TextFits do
			Description.Size = Description.Size + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)

			if Description.Size.Y.Offset > 500 then
				break
			end
		end

		-- Update container
		wait()
		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, guiWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
	end

	--- Shows the auto complete menu with the given list and possible options
	-- item = {typedText, suggestedText, options?=options}
	-- The options table is optional. `at` should only be passed into AutoComplete::Show
	-- name, type, and description may be passed in an options dictionary inside the items as well
	-- options.at?: the character index at which to show the menu
	-- options.name?: The name to display in the info box
	-- options.type?: The type to display in the info box
	-- options.prefix?: The current type prefix (%Team)
	-- options.description?: The description for the currently active info box
	-- options.invalid?: If true, description is shown in red.
	-- options.isLast?: If true, auto complete won't keep going after this argument.
	function AutoComplete:Show (items, options)
		options = options or {}

		-- Remove old options.
		for _, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			if item.gui then
				item.gui:Destroy()
			end
		end

		-- Reset state
		self.SelectedItem = 1
		self.Items = items
		self.Prefix = options.prefix or ""
		self.LastItem = options.isLast or false
		self.Command = options.command
		self.Arg = options.arg
		self.NumArgs = options.numArgs
		self.IsPartial = options.isPartial

		-- Generate the new option labels
		local autocompleteWidth = 200

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			local leftText = item[1]
			local rightText = item[2]

			if Shorthands[leftText] then
				leftText = rightText
			end

			local btn = AutoItem:Clone()
			btn.Name = leftText .. rightText
			btn.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
			btn.Typed.Text = leftText
			btn.Suggest.Text = string.rep(" ", #leftText) .. rightText:sub(#leftText + 1)
			btn.Parent = Gui
			btn.LayoutOrder = i

			local maxBounds = math.max(btn.Typed.TextBounds.X, btn.Suggest.TextBounds.X) + 20
			if maxBounds > autocompleteWidth then
				autocompleteWidth = maxBounds
			end

			item.gui = btn
		end

		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()

		-- Todo: Use TextService to find accurate position for auto complete box
		local text = Entry.TextBox.Text
		local words = Util.SplitString(text)
		if text:sub(#text, #text) == " " and not options.at then
			words[#words+1] = "e"
		end
		table.remove(words, #words)
		local extra = (options.at and options.at or (#table.concat(words, " ") + 1)) * 7

		-- Update the auto complete container
		Gui.Position = UDim2.new(0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.X - 10 + extra, 0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.Y + 30)
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, autocompleteWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
		Gui.Visible = true

		-- Finally, update thge info display
		UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[1] and self.Items[1].options or options)
	end

	--- Returns the selected item in the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem ()
		if Gui.Visible == false then
			return nil
		end

		return AutoComplete.Items[AutoComplete.SelectedItem]
	end

	--- Hides the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:Hide ()
		Gui.Visible = false
	end

	--- Returns if the menu is visible
	function AutoComplete:IsVisible ()
		return Gui.Visible
	end

	--- Changes the user's item selection by the given delta
	function AutoComplete:Select (delta)
		if not Gui.Visible then return end

		self.SelectedItem = self.SelectedItem + delta

		if self.SelectedItem > #self.Items then
			self.SelectedItem = 1
		elseif self.SelectedItem < 1 then
			self.SelectedItem = #self.Items
		end

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			item.gui.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
		end

		if self.Items[self.SelectedItem] and self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options then
			UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options or {})
		end
	end

	return AutoComplete
end
